daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive, and the wāw is for resumption. ﴿أَحَدٌ﴾ the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by the verb mentioned after it. ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أحد. ﴿اسْتَجارَكَ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is "هو"; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَجِرْهُ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, its fāʿil being "أنت", and the hāʾ is its object; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَسْمَعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a latent أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from حتى and the verb is in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أجره. ﴿كَلامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَبْلِغْهُ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its first object, and ﴿مَأْمَنَهُ﴾ its second object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun, and ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as an adjective of قوم. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أنّ with its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar.

daas-irab:7-7.t:
﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَكُونُ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿عَهْدٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَعِنْدَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿رَسُولِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. It is also possible to parse يكون as a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, with the interrogative noun كيف as its fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl from عهد: it was an adjective (ṣifa) of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted adjective of عهد. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative by exception.
﴿عاهَدْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ adjective; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَمَا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is the two clauses of the condition. ﴿اسْتَقامُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the verb is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿فَاسْتَقِيمُوا﴾ the fāʾ is linking, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. The clause ﴿يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ is its khabar.

daas-irab:8-8.t:
﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of an omitted verb, i.e. "كيف تعاهدونهم..؟" (how can you make a covenant with them?). And in وإن the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and إن is conditional. ﴿يَظْهَرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يَرْقُبُوا﴾ a jussive imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is negating. ﴿فِيكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined to إذا or the fāʾ. ﴿إِلًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ذِمَّةً﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿يُرْضُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, the kāf its object, and the mīm is for the masculine plural.
The clause is resumptive. ﴿بِأَفْواهِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿وَتَأْبى قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ فاسِقُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿اشْتَرَوْا بِآياتِ﴾ a past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثَمَناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ adjective (ṣifa). The clause is resumptive. ﴿فَصَدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿ساءَ﴾ a past verb, and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is its fāʿil, and its object is omitted, i.e. "ساءهم".. The clause ساء is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. It is also possible to parse ساء as an inflexible (jāmid) past verb like بئس, whose fāʿil is omitted and explained by the verb mentioned after it, and ﴿ما﴾ as an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun, and the clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is its khabar. The clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun on the parsing of ما as a relative noun. The clause إنهم ساء.. is resumptive.

daas-irab:10-10.t: Its i'rab preceded two verses earlier. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a nominative pronoun, a second mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿الْمُعْتَدُونَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ﴿هُمُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ﴾ is the khabar of the demonstrative.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿فَإِنْ تابُوا﴾ إن is conditional, and the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) is initial and has no grammatical position; the verbal clauses after it, ﴿وَأَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكاةَ﴾, are conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فَإِخْوانُكُمْ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "فهم إخوانكم" (then they are your brothers). ﴿فِي الدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from إخوانكم; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَنُفَصِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَإِنْ نَكَثُوا﴾ إن is conditional, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿أَيْمانَهُمْ﴾ its object. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from أيمانهم. ﴿عَهْدِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَطَعَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي دِينِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فَقاتِلُوا أَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿لا أَيْمانَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿أَيْمانَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). The clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun, and the clause ﴿يَنْتَهُونَ﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause لعلهم.. is causal and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:13-13.t:
﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of urging. ﴿تُقاتِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and ﴿قَوْماً﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. The clause ﴿نَكَثُوا أَيْمانَهُمْ﴾ is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَهَمُّوا﴾ the verbal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿بِإِخْراجِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
﴿الرَّسُولِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿بَدَؤُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to the verb. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the hamza is for interrogation, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَخْشَوْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the omitted bāʾ, and both are attached to أحق, i.e. "الله أحق بالخشية" (Allah is more deserving of being feared). ﴿أَنْ﴾ conditional. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَنْ﴾; the conditional particle in the verse is إِنْ.] ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ its khabar, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is initial and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t:
﴿قاتِلُوهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ its object. ﴿يُعَذِّبْهُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the imperative, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿بِأَيْدِيكُمْ﴾ أيديكم is a noun genitive by the bāʾ, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. ﴿وَيُخْزِهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to يعذبهم, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, namely the yāʾ, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). Likewise the clause ﴿يَنْصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ and the clause ﴿يَشْفِ صُدُورَ﴾.
﴿وَيَشْفِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿صُدُورَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is fāʿil (agent); the wāw is for resumption, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ من is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يتوب. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. And ﴿اللَّهُ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is for resumption. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ first khabar (predicate). ﴿حَكِيمٌ﴾ second khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:101-102.t: ﴿وَمِمَّنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; مِن is a preposition and مَن is a relative noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿حَوْلَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الْأَعْرابِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مُنافِقُونَ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَمِنْ أَهْلِ﴾ conjoined to وممّن and attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَرَدُوا عَلَى النِّفاقِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb مردوا; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of المنافقون. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَعْلَمُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent and the hāʾ its object, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿سَنُعَذِّبُهُمْ﴾ the sīn denotes the future, an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent and the hāʾ its object, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾ standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُرَدُّونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلى عَذابٍ﴾ the two are attached to يردون. ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ naʿt, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَآخَرُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿اعْتَرَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is a naʿt of آخرون. ﴿بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to اعترفوا. ﴿خَلَطُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَمَلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿صالِحاً﴾ naʿt. ﴿وَآخَرَ﴾ conjoined to عملا. ﴿سَيِّئاً﴾ naʿt of آخر. ﴿عَسَى﴾ one of the verbs of hope, which puts the ism (subject) in the nominative and the khabar in the accusative. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its ism. ﴿أَنْ﴾ subjunctive-making. ﴿يَتُوبَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يتوب. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its ism and its two khabars, and the clause is causal, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:103-105.t: ﴿خُذْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ أَمْوالِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to خذ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿صَدَقَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تُطَهِّرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَتُزَكِّيهِمْ﴾ conjoined to وتطهرهم. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to تزكيهم. ﴿وَصَلِّ﴾ conjoined to خذ; it is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to صل. ﴿إِنَّ صَلاتَكَ﴾ inna and its ism (subject). ﴿سَكَنٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the clause is causal. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to سكن. ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and a jussive-making particle. ﴿يَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أنّ and its ism; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أنّ with its ism and khabar takes the place of the two objects of يعلموا. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of أنّ. ﴿يَقْبَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿التَّوْبَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of هو. ﴿عَنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يقبل. ﴿وَيَأْخُذُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّدَقاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra, a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its ism, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ two khabars of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of أنّ. ﴿وَقُلِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil, عملكم is mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ both conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَسَتُرَدُّونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى عالِمِ﴾ the two are attached to ستردون. ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالشَّهادَةِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its ism, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم.

daas-irab:106-107.t: ﴿وَآخَرُونَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مُرْجَوْنَ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of آخرون. ﴿لِأَمْرِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to مرجون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing. ﴿يُعَذِّبُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ its object, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَإِمَّا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَتُوبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يتوب. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ. ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مَسْجِداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ضِراراً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَكُفْراً وَتَفْرِيقاً﴾ both conjoined to ضرارا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to تفريقا. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِرْصاداً﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the lām is a preposition and من is a relative noun; the two are attached to إرصادا. ﴿حارَبَ اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb, the Name of Majesty is its object, the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the two are attached to حارب; قبل is an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, in the position of genitive (majrūr). ﴿وَلَيَحْلِفُنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ) [Translator's note: so in the source; this lām is usually identified as the lām in the answer of an implied oath]; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was deleted to avoid a succession of identical letters; the deleted wāw is its fāʿil, deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the nūn of emphasis is a particle with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَرَدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْحُسْنى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَشْهَدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its ism (subject), and the clause is causal. ﴿لَكاذِبُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and كاذبون is the khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:108-109.t: ﴿لا﴾ the jussive-making lā of prohibition. ﴿تَقُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تقم. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ an adverb of time attached to تقم. ﴿لَمَسْجِدٌ﴾ the lām is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and مسجد is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أُسِّسَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿عَلَى التَّقْوى﴾ the two are attached to أسس. ﴿مِنْ أَوَّلِ﴾ the two are attached to أسس. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾ khabar (predicate) of مسجد. ﴿أَنْ تَقُومَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by أن, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to تقوم; أن and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿رِجالٌ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُحِبُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of رجال. ﴿أَنْ﴾ subjunctive-making. ﴿يَتَطَهَّرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the object of يحبون. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُحِبُّ الْمُطَّهِّرِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَسَّسَ بُنْيانَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object; the hāʾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation, the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلى تَقْوى﴾ the two are attached to أسس. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of تقوى. ﴿وَرِضْوانٍ﴾ conjoined to تقوى. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar of من. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿مِنَ﴾ conjoined to the preceding من, so it is a mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿مِنَ﴾; the Quranic text reads ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿أَسَّسَ بُنْيانَهُ﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلى شَفا﴾ the two are attached to أسس. ﴿جُرُفٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هارٍ﴾ naʿt of جرف. ﴿فَانْهارَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to انهار. ﴿فِي نارِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿الْقَوْمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ naʿt of القوم, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:110-111.t: ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَزالُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بُنْيانُهُمُ﴾ its ism (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of بنيانهم. ﴿بَنَوْا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the deleted alif; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿رِيبَةً﴾ khabar (predicate) of لا يزال, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt of ريبة. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ﴾ subjunctive-making. ﴿تَقَطَّعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن. ﴿قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as the excepted. [Translator's note: the source prints the word with kasra; as fāʿil it is ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ in the Quranic text.] ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, with a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ a particle resembling the verb, and the Name of Majesty is its ism; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اشْتَرى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the two are attached to اشترى. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَمْوالَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to أنفسهم. ﴿بِأَنَّ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ the two are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ the ism of أنّ; أنّ and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اشترى. ﴿يُقاتِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to يقاتلون, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَيَقْتُلُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the imperfect verb is nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَيُقْتَلُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of وعدا. ﴿حَقًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿فِي التَّوْراةِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of وعدا. ﴿وَالْإِنْجِيلِ﴾ conjoined to التوراة. ﴿وَالْقُرْآنِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوْفى﴾ khabar, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿بِعَهْدِهِ﴾ the two are attached to أوفى. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to أوفى. ﴿فَاسْتَبْشِرُوا﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿بِبَيْعِكُمُ﴾ the two are attached to استبشروا. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive as a naʿt. ﴿بايَعْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to بايعتم. ﴿وَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ; the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْفَوْزُ﴾ khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَظِيمُ﴾ naʿt, and the clause is the khabar of ذلك.

daas-irab:112-113.t: ﴿التَّائِبُونَ الْعابِدُونَ الْحامِدُونَ السَّائِحُونَ الرَّاكِعُونَ السَّاجِدُونَ الْآمِرُونَ﴾ these are multiple khabars (predicates) of a preceding mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because they are sound masculine plurals. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to الآمرون. ﴿وَالنَّاهُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ﴾ the two are attached to الناهون. ﴿وَالْحافِظُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِحُدُودِ﴾ the two are attached to الحافظون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَبَشِّرِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلنَّبِيِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to النبي. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its subjunctive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of nominative as the delayed ism (subject) of kāna. ﴿لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ the two are attached to يستغفروا. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism, and the clause is circumstantial. ﴿أُولِي﴾ khabar, accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿قُرْبى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to يستغفروا. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَبَيَّنَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to تبين. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ and its ism. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾ khabar of أنّ; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of تبين. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:114-114.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿اسْتِغْفارُ﴾ its ism (subject). ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to استغفار; genitive with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَنْ مَوْعِدَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿وَعَدَها﴾ a past verb and its first object; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of موعدة. ﴿إِيَّاهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and لما is an adverb of time. ﴿تَبَيَّنَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to تبين. ﴿أَنَّهُ عَدُوٌّ﴾ أنّ, its ism and its khabar; the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil of تبين. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to عدو. ﴿تَبَرَّأَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ the two are attached to تبرأ. ﴿إِنَّ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿لَأَوَّاهٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and أواه is khabar. ﴿حَلِيمٌ﴾ a second khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:115-116.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty is its ism (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيُضِلَّ قَوْماً﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by the implied أن; قوما is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to يضل. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb, annexed to بعد. ﴿هَداهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, the fāʿil latent, and the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يُبَيِّنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by the implied أن after حتى, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يبين. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its ism. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to عليم. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its ism, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿يُحْيِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is a second khabar of inna. ﴿وَيُمِيتُ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to يحيي. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: the source prints the Name with fatḥa here; as muḍāf ilayhi it is ﴿اللَّهِ﴾.] ﴿مِنْ وَلِيٍّ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and ولي is a noun genitive in form, nominative in position as a delayed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant. ﴿نَصِيرٍ﴾ conjoined to من ولي.

daas-irab:117-118.t: ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿تابَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the answer of an omitted oath. ﴿عَلَى النَّبِيِّ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تاب. ﴿الْمُهاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنْصارِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of what precedes it. ﴿اتَّبَعُوهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي ساعَةِ﴾ the two are attached to اتبعوا. ﴿الْعُسْرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to اتبعوا. ﴿ما﴾ negating. [Translator's note: so in the source; ما here is usually taken as maṣdar-forming.] ﴿كادَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; its ism (subject) is omitted, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَزِيغُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿قُلُوبُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فَرِيقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to فريق. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تابَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to تاب. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its ism, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar (predicate). ﴿رَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ two khabars of inna. ﴿وَعَلَى الثَّلاثَةِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, naʿt of ثلاثة. ﴿خُلِّفُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿ضاقَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ marks the feminine. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾ the two are attached to ضاقت. ﴿أَنْفُسُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَظَنُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾ lightened from أنّ, and its ism is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and what follows it takes the place of the two objects of ظن. And ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation. ﴿مَلْجَأَ﴾ the ism of lā. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted badal (substitute) of الله. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تابَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾ the two are attached to تاب. ﴿لِيَتُوبُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation; an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تاب. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its ism. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ two khabars of inna, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:119-120.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative (manṣūb); the hā is for alerting, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause is initial. ﴿وَكُونُوا﴾ kāna and its ism (subject), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ kāna, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a relative noun conjoined to أهل. ﴿حَوْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the ṣila of the relative noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْأَعْرابِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنْ﴾ subjunctive-making. ﴿يَتَخَلَّفُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن, the sign of its subjunctive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the ism of kāna. ﴿عَنْ رَسُولِ﴾ the two are attached to يتخلفوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا يَرْغَبُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, subjunctive by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يرغبوا. ﴿عَنْ نَفْسِهِ﴾ the two are attached to يرغبوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām denotes distance and the kāf is for address, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition; أنّ and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive, and the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُصِيبُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the clause is the khabar of أنّ. ﴿ظَمَأٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿نَصَبٌ وَلا مَخْمَصَةٌ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of what preceded. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يَطَؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَوْطِئاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يَغِيظُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿الْكُفَّارَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is a naʿt of موطئا. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يَنالُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ عَدُوٍّ﴾ the two are attached to ينالون. ﴿نَيْلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to كتب. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to كتب. ﴿عَمَلٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿صالِحٌ﴾ naʿt of عمل. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its ism, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُضِيعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction expressing digression (iḍrāb). ﴿حَسِبْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تُتْرَكُوا﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb stands in place of the two objects of حسب. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿لَمَّا﴾ a particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿يَعْلَمِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn, and it was given a kasra to avoid the meeting of two quiescent letters. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, its object; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause ﴿جاهَدُوا مِنْكُمْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا﴾ a jussive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿اللَّهُ﴾; in the verse the word is اللَّهِ, genitive.] ﴿وَلا رَسُولِهِ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿وَلَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلِيجَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is attached to خبير; or ما is a relative noun and the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:17-17.t:
﴿ما كانَ﴾ ما is negating and كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿أَنْ يَعْمُرُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of nominative as the noun of كان. ﴿مَساجِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿شاهِدِينَ﴾ an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿عَلى أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the active participle شاهدين, and likewise ﴿بِالْكُفْرِ﴾ is attached to the active participle. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حَبِطَتْ أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar. ﴿وَفِي النَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar خالدون. ﴿هُمْ خالِدُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf), and the clause أولئك.. is resumptive.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining particle and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَعْمُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and ﴿مَساجِدَ﴾ is its object. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَنْ﴾ the relative noun, its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. The clause ﴿آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَأَقامَ الصَّلاةَ وَآتَى الزَّكاةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ﴾ conjoined clauses. يخش is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil being "هو". ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿اللَّهِ﴾; in the verse the word is اللَّهَ, accusative.] ﴿فَعَسى﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). ﴿عسى﴾ an inflexible (jāmid) past verb that puts the noun in the nominative and the khabar (predicate) in the accusative. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of nominative as its noun. ﴿أَنْ يَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the defective verb يكونوا. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of accusative as the khabar of the verb عسى, and the clause فعسى.. has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition that does not put the verb in the jussive.

daas-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أَجَعَلْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿سِقايَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb جعل. ﴿الْحاجِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَعِمارَةَ﴾ conjoined to سقاية. ﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾
adjective (ṣifa). ﴿كَمَنْ﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi, and it is muḍāf. ﴿من﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. "أجعلتم سقاية الحاج.. مثل الإيمان بالله..؟" (have you made the giving of drink to the pilgrims.. like belief in Allah?). The clause ﴿آمَنَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty in the position of genitive; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمن. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). The clause ﴿وَجاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿لا يَسْتَوُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, to which the adverb ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ is attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and لا is negating. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ لا يَهْدِي﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:20-20.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿أَعْظَمُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿دَرَجَةً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعظم. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿وَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْفائِزُونَ﴾ is resumptive.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿يُبَشِّرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object, and ﴿رَبُّهُمْ﴾ is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة; the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَرِضْوانٍ وَجَنَّاتٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿لَهُمْ، فِيها﴾ attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿نَعِيمٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُقِيمٌ﴾ adjective. The nominal clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of جنات.

daas-irab:22-22.t:
﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ an adverb of time, attached to the active participle خالدين. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَجْرٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ adjective (ṣifa). The clause ﴿عِنْدَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ. [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the verse is إنّ.]
The clause إن الله عنده.. is resumptive.

daas-irab:23-23.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; and ها is for alerting. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute).
﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿لا تَتَّخِذُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿آباءَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿وَإِخْوانَكُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿اسْتَحَبُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿الْكُفْرَ﴾ its object. ﴿عَلَى الْإِيمانِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause of the condition has no grammatical position, being initial, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "إن استحبوا الكفر على الإيمان فلا تتخذوهم أولياء" (if they prefer unbelief over belief, then do not take them as allies). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is for resumption.
﴿يَتَوَلَّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, the protasis, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, namely the alif; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the nominal clause من يتولهم is resumptive. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the clause of the protasis with its apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿من﴾.

daas-irab:24-24.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿آباؤُكُمْ﴾ its noun, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma. ﴿وَأَبْناؤُكُمْ وَإِخْوانُكُمْ وَأَزْواجُكُمْ وَعَشِيرَتُكُمْ وَأَمْوالٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿اقْتَرَفْتُمُوها﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is due to the lengthening of the ḍamma of the mīm; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَتِجارَةٌ﴾ conjoined to أموال. ﴿تَخْشَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿كَسادَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective, and likewise ﴿وَمَساكِنُ تَرْضَوْنَها﴾. ﴿أَحَبَّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) أحب, and likewise ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ is attached to it. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ وَجِهادٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) جهاد. ﴿فَتَرَبَّصُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَأْتِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a latent أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from حتى and the verb is in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿اللَّهِ﴾; in the verse the word is اللَّهُ, nominative.] ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to يأتي. ﴿وَاللَّهُ لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفاسِقِينَ﴾ the i'rab of something similar has preceded.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath. قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿نَصَرَكُمُ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي مَواطِنَ﴾ a noun genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra, a diptote on the pattern مفاعل, the form of the ultimate plural (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ). The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَثِيرَةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive with the kasra. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "ونصركم يوم حنين" (and He helped you on the day of Ḥunayn); the implied clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿حُنَيْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the kasra, on the view that it is not a diptote. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from يوم. ﴿أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿كَثْرَتُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فَلَمْ﴾ لم is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past), and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿تُغْنِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, the yāʾ. The fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي". ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَضاقَتْ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ are attached, and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and ﴿الْأَرْضُ﴾ is fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival), interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the bāʾ. ﴿رَحُبَتْ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ضاقت. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿وَلَّيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. ﴿مُدْبِرِينَ﴾ an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلى رَسُولِهِ﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ are conjoined; ﴿اللَّهُ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil, and ﴿سَكِينَتَهُ﴾ its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf), and likewise the clause ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ جُنُوداً﴾ is conjoined. ﴿لَمْ﴾ putting the verb in the jussive. ﴿تَرَوْها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). And ﴿عَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿جَزاءُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the relative noun in the verse is مَنْ.], and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يتوب; the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:28-28.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has been repeated earlier. ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ a restraining particle and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is initial. ﴿فَلا يَقْرَبُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). لا is prohibitive, putting the verb in the jussive, and the fāʾ before it is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). ﴿الْمَسْجِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْحَرامَ﴾ adjective (ṣifa). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
﴿عامِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هذا﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive as an adjective; the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional, putting the verb in the jussive.
﴿خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn because it is joined to the vowelled tāʾ of the agent; the tāʾ is an attached pronoun, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of nominative as fāʿil, and the mīm is for the masculine plural, and عيلة is its object; the verb is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause of the protasis is initial. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ a particle of the future, and the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يُغْنِيكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness. The kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿شاءَ﴾ a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عليم حكيم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿قاتِلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَلا بِالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلا يُحَرِّمُونَ ما﴾ a verb and its fāʿil, and the relative noun ما is its object; the verbal clause is conjoined. The clause ﴿حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَلا يَدِينُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿دِينَ﴾ a noun accusative by removal of the preposition, or mafʿūl bihi on the view that يدينون is made to carry the meaning of يعتنقون (they embrace). ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object; ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ is the second object; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يُعْطُوا﴾ an accusative imperfect verb; the maṣdar formed from حتى and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قاتلوا. ﴿الْجِزْيَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَنْ يَدٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُمْ صاغِرُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وَقالَتِ الْيَهُودُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the tāʾ is for the feminine; it was given a kasra to avoid the meeting of two quiescent letters; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عُزَيْرٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ابْنُ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said). ﴿وَقالَتِ النَّصارى الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ اللَّهِ﴾ .. conjoined (maʿṭūf), and its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿قَوْلُهُمْ﴾ its khabar. ﴿بِأَفْواهِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun); the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿يُضاهِؤُنَ قَوْلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause يضاهئون is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿قاتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّى﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿يُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:121-122.t: ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿نَفَقَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿صَغِيرَةً﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَلا كَبِيرَةً﴾ conjoined to صغيرة. ﴿وَلا يَقْطَعُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined, and the i'rab is clear. ﴿وادِياً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to كتب. ﴿لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation; an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كتب. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism (subject), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ kāna and its ism, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيَنْفِرُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied أن after the lām of denial, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to the khabar of kāna. ﴿كَافَّةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلَوْلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿نَفَرَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to نفر. ﴿فِرْقَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿طائِفَةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿لِيَتَفَقَّهُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, subjunctive by the implied أن after the lām of causation, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to نفر. ﴿فِي الدِّينِ﴾ the two are attached to يتفقهوا. ﴿وَلِيُنْذِرُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿قَوْمَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿رَجَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to رجعوا. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its ism, and the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَحْذَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of laʿalla.

daas-irab:123-124.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), and hā is for alerting; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute) of أيّ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قاتِلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَلُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to يلونكم. ﴿وَلْيَجِدُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يجدوا. ﴿غِلْظَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أنّ and its ism (subject). ﴿مَعَ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ مع is an adverb of place, and المتقين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أنّ and what follows it takes the place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the tāʾ in أنزلت marks the feminine, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَيُّكُمْ﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿زادَتْهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ the hā is for alerting, and ذه is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿إِيماناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and أمّا is a particle of condition and detailing. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَزادَتْهُمْ إِيماناً﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis; a past verb and its first object, and the tāʾ marks the feminine. ﴿إِيماناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هم is mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

daas-irab:125-127.t: ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and parsed like it. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾ a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَزادَتْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of the condition أمّا; a past verb, the tāʾ marks the feminine, the hāʾ is its first object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿رِجْساً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَى رِجْسِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to رجسا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَماتُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ كافِرُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), with a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is circumstantial. ﴿أَوَلا﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating. ﴿يَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ and its ism (subject), and the clause takes the place of the two objects of يرون. ﴿يُفْتَنُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar. ﴿فِي كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to يفتنون. ﴿عامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَرَّةً﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾ conjoined to مرة. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَتُوبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَإِذا ما أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ نَظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلى بَعْضٍ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَراكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif owing to impossibility, and the kāf is its object. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾ fāʿil, genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative in position; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "يقولون هل". ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿انْصَرَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿صَرَفَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, with أنّ and its ism; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أنّ and what follows it is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to صرف. ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾ khabar of أنهم. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَفْقَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:128-129.t: ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿رَسُولٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسول, and the clause is the answer of an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَزِيزٌ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to عزيز. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is a naʿt of رسول. ﴿عَنِتُّمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿حَرِيصٌ﴾ naʿt of رسول. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to حريص. ﴿بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the two are attached to رؤوف. ﴿رَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ two naʿts of رسول. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and إن is conditional. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis. ﴿حَسْبِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, governing like inna. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ the ism (subject) of lā. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ badal (substitute) of the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to توكلت. ﴿تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is mubtadaʾ, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَبُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾ naʿt.

daas-irab:31-31.t:
﴿اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبارَهُمْ وَرُهْبانَهُمْ أَرْباباً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its two objects; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أربابا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْمَسِيحَ﴾ conjoined to رهبانهم. ﴿ابْنَ﴾ an accusative adjective.
﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra; a diptote because it is a proper name and feminine. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ما is negating. ﴿أُمِرُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِيَعْبُدُوا﴾ an accusative imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar formed from the latent أن after the lām of cause and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿إِلهاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿واحِداً﴾ adjective. ﴿لا إِلهَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "موجود" (existing). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from إله according to its position; the clause is in the position of accusative as a second adjective of إله. ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival), interpreted together with the imperfect verb ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ after it as an interpreted maṣdar in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the maṣdar سبحانه. Or ما is a relative noun and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أَنْ﴾, which puts the verb in the accusative, and the verb ﴿يُطْفِؤُا﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نُورَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِأَفْواهِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَيَأْبَى اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). The interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أَنْ﴾ and the verb ﴿يُتِمَّ﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُورَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is conditional. ﴿كَرِهَ الْكافِرُونَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "ولو كره الكافرون سيتم الله نوره" (even if the unbelievers dislike it, Allah will complete His light).

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative noun after it is its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدى﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; رسول is its object and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَدِينِ﴾ conjoined to الهدى. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيُظْهِرَهُ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar formed from the latent أن after the lām of cause and the imperfect verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسل. ﴿عَلَى الدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb يظهر. ﴿كُلِّهِ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ﴾ like ولو كره الكافرون.

daas-irab:34-34.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ the noun of إنّ. ﴿مِنَ الْأَحْبارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كثيرا. ﴿وَالرُّهْبانِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿لَيَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).
﴿أَمْوالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالْباطِلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined.
﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is for resumption. The clause ﴿يَكْنِزُونَ﴾ الذهب ﴿وَالْفِضَّةَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وَلا يُنْفِقُونَها﴾ .. is conjoined. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَبَشِّرْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the hāʾ is its object; the fāʾ occurs in the answer of the relative noun because of its resemblance to a condition. ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿أَلِيمٍ﴾ adjective (ṣifa). The verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عذاب أليم﴾ or to the omitted verb اذكر. [Translator's note: so in the source; يوم is an adverb of time.] ﴿يُحْمى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its appearance prevented by impossibility. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), i.e. "يوم تحمى النار عليهم" (the day the fire is heated over them); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِي نارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, on account of being a proper name and foreign. ﴿فَتُكْوى﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿جِباهُهُمْ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿وَجُنُوبُهُمْ وَظُهُورُهُمْ﴾ conjoined nouns. ﴿هذا ما﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative noun is in the position of nominative as its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said) of an implied verb of saying. ﴿كَنَزْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿تَكْنِزُونَ﴾ is its khabar.

daas-irab:36-36.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿عِدَّةَ﴾ the noun of إنّ. ﴿الشُّهُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from عدة. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اثْنا﴾ the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the alif because it is a dual.
﴿عَشَرَ﴾ a part (of the compound number), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position. ﴿شَهْراً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿فِي كِتابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of اثنا عشر. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to an omitted adjective of اثنا عشر, or to كتاب on the view that it is a maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ its object, accusative with the kasra, a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿أَرْبَعَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حُرُمٌ﴾ adjective.
