It is also read: "إن يُعْفَ عن طائفة منكم تُعَذّب طائفةٌ", and "إن يُعْفَ... يُعَذّب طائفَة".

farraa:67-67.t: His saying: ﴿وَيَقْبِضُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾: they hold back from spending on [the cause of] the Prophet ﷺ.

farraa:69-69.t:
His saying: ﴿كَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ﴾, that is: you have acted like the actions of those before you.
His saying: ﴿فَٱسْتَمْتَعُواْ بِخَلاقِهِمْ﴾: He says: they were content with their share in this world in exchange for their shares in the Hereafter.
His saying: ﴿فَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ﴾, that is: you wanted what those before you wanted.
His saying: ﴿وَخُضْتُمْ كَٱلَّذِي خَاضُوۤاْ﴾ means: like their plunging in which they plunged.

farraa:70-70.t:
His saying: ﴿وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَاتِ أَتَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ﴾: it is said that they are the villages of the people of Lūṭ, Hūd and Ṣāliḥ. It is also said that they are the people of Lūṭ specifically.
They were pluralised with tāʾ on the basis of His saying: ﴿والْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَى﴾. It is as though, when it was said ﴿وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَاتِ أَتَتْهُمْ﴾, their pluralisation was in terms of factions and groups, as it was said: "I killed the Fudaykāt", relating them to their chief, Abū Fudayk.

farraa:72-72.t: His saying: ﴿وَرِضْوَانٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ﴾ is nominative by أكبر [as its khabar (predicate)]. It was turned away from being coordinated with what precedes it, though it is among the things Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, has promised them; but it was singled out with the nominative to show its superiority, as you say in speech: "I have favoured you with dirhams and clothes, but my good opinion [of you] is better for you than that."

farraa:74-74.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا نَقَمُوۤاْ إِلاَّ أَنْ أَغْنَاهُمُ ٱللَّهُ﴾: this is a reproach to them, because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to the people of Medina while they were in need, and they became rich from the spoils. So He said: they resented nothing but the wealth. So (أنْ) is in the position of the accusative.

farraa:79-79.t:
His saying: ﴿ٱلَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ ٱلْمُطَّوِّعِينَ﴾: what is meant is al-mutaṭawwiʿīn (the volunteers); the tāʾ was assimilated to the ṭāʾ and became a doubled ṭāʾ. Likewise (ومن يَطَّوَّعْ خَيْرا) and (والْمُطَّهِّرِينَ).
Their lamz of them is their disparaging them. That was because the Prophet ﷺ urged the people to give alms, and ʿUmar brought alms, and ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān brought great alms, as did some of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ. Then a man called Abū ʿUqayl came with a ṣāʿ of dates. The hypocrites said: "These people brought out their alms only for show; and as for Abū ʿUqayl, he only brought his ṣāʿ to get himself mentioned." So Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, revealed: ﴿ٱلَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ ٱلْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ﴾, meaning the Emigrants, ﴿وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَجِدُونَ إِلاَّ جُهْدَهُمْ﴾,
meaning Abū ʿUqayl. Al-juhd is the dialect of the people of the Ḥijāz, as is al-wujd; the dialect of others is al-jahd and al-wajd.

farraa:83-83.t: His saying: ﴿فَٱقْعُدُواْ مَعَ ٱلْخَالِفِينَ﴾: of men [one says] khulūf and khālifūn; and of women khawālif: those who stay behind in the house and do not leave. It is also said ʿabd khālif and ṣāḥib khālif ("a contrary slave", "a contrary companion") when he is contrary (mukhālif).

farraa:90-90.t: His saying: ﴿وَجَآءَ ٱلْمُعَذِّرُونَ﴾: they are those who have an excuse. In meaning it is al-muʿtadhirūn (those who excuse themselves), but the tāʾ was assimilated to the dhāl and both became a doubled dhāl, as in yadhdhakkarūna and yadhdhakkaru. It is like (يخَصِّمونَ) for whoever gives the khāʾ a fatḥa; likewise the ʿayn was given a fatḥa because the vowel of the tāʾ passed to the ʿayn; it was — and Allah knows best — al-muʿtadhirūn. As for al-muʿadhdhir on the pattern of mufaʿʿil, he is one who makes excuses without [having] an excuse. Muḥammad related to us: al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: Abū Bakr ibn ʿAyyāsh related to me from al-Kalbī from Abū Ṣāliḥ from Ibn ʿAbbās; and Abū Ḥafṣ al-Kharrāz from Juwaybir from al-Ḍaḥḥāk from Ibn ʿAbbās, that he read (المُعْذِرون), and said: "May Allah curse the muʿadhdhirīn", meaning those who make excuses without an excuse; and al-muʿdhir is one who has gone to the utmost limit of excuse. Al-muʿtadhir may have the meaning of al-muʿdhir, and may be one who has no excuse. Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, said concerning those who have no excuse: ﴿يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ﴾.

farraa:92-92.t:
His saying: ﴿حَزَناً أَلاَّ يَجِدُواْ﴾: (يَجِدُوا) is in the position of the accusative by أن. It would [also be permissible] if it were nominative, making (لا) in the manner of (ليس), as if you said: "in grief that they do not find (أن ليس يجدون) what to spend". Like it is His saying: ﴿أَفَلاَ يَرَوْنَ أَنْ لاَ يَرْجِعُ إلَيْهمْ قَوْلاً﴾, and His saying: ﴿وحَسِبُوا أَنْ لاَ تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ﴾.
Wherever (ليس) is suitable in place of (لا), you may put the verb after (لا) in the nominative or in the accusative.
[Translator's note: the apodosis of «ولو كانت رفعا» ("and if it were nominative…") is not stated in the source; "it would also be permissible" is supplied from the context.]

farraa:94-94.t:
His saying: ﴿يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ﴾, then He said: (لاَ تَعْتَذِرُوا): you have no excuse. Labīd said, in the sense of iʿtidhār as iʿdhār, when he made them one:
وقُوما فقولا بالذى قد علمتما * ولا تخمِشا وجها ولا تحلقا الشعر
إلى الحول ثم اسمُ السلام عليكما * ومَنْ يبكِ حولا كاملا فقد اعتذر
(Rise, you two, and say what you know; do not scratch a face nor shave the hair — until a year [has passed]; then the name of peace be upon you both: whoever weeps a full year has done all that excuse requires.)
He means: فقد أعذر.

farraa:97-97.t:
His saying: ﴿ٱلأَعْرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفْراً وَنِفَاقاً﴾ was revealed about a group of the Bedouins of Asad and Ghaṭafān and those living near Medina. (أجدر) is like your saying aḥrā and akhlaq ("more fitting", "more likely").
﴿وَأَجْدَرُ أَلاَّ يَعْلَمُواْ﴾: the position of (أن) is accusative. Wherever (أن) comes and the speech before it is complete with what it has put in the genitive, nominative or accusative, (أن) is in the position of the accusative; as in your saying: أتيتك أنّك محسن ("I came to you because you are good"), قمت أنك مسىء ("I stood because you are bad"), and ثَبَتُّ عنك أنك صديق وصاحب. It has become clear to you that (أن) is in the position of the accusative because you can put the maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of (أن) and it is accusative; do you not see that you say: أتيتك إحسانَك ("I came to you for your goodness")? So الإحسان, by its accusative, shows the accusative of أن; and likewise the other two.
As for His saying: ﴿وَأَجْدَرُ أَلاَّ يَعْلَمُواْ﴾, putting the maṣdar in the place of (أن) is ugly, because akhlaq and ajdar require the future of verbs, and so with (أن) the future is made clear; whereas if you put a maṣdar in place of (أن), its futurity is not made clear, and that is ugly. And (أن) is in the position of the accusative in every case; do you not see that you say أظن أنك قائم ("I think that you are standing") and judge (أن) to be accusative, while it is not proper to say أظن قيامك ("I think your standing")? So aẓunnu is parallel to khalīq, to ʿasā, (jadīr), ajdar and their inflected forms as regards (أن).

farraa:98-98.t:
His saying: ﴿وَيَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمُ ٱلدَّوَائِرَ﴾ means: death and being killed.
Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, says: ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ﴾. Giving the sīn of (السوء) a fatḥa is the proper form of speech and the reading of most of the readers. Mujāhid gave the sīn a ḍamma in two places: here and in Sūrat al-Fatḥ. Whoever says "دائرة السَّوء" intends the maṣdar of suʾtuhu: sawʾan, masāʾatan, masāʾiyatan and sawāʾiyatan; these are maṣdars. Whoever gives the sīn a ḍamma makes it a noun, as you say: "upon him is the turn of trial and punishment." It is not permissible to put a ḍamma on the ʿayn in His saying: ﴿ما كان أبوكِ امرَأَ سَوْء﴾, nor in His saying: ﴿وظننتُمْ ظَنَّ السَّوْء﴾, because it is the opposite of your saying: "this is a man of truth (ṣidq)" and "a garment of truth [i.e. of good quality]". So al-sawʾ here has no sense of punishment or trial, such that it would take a ḍamma.
[Translator's note: by "the ʿayn" the author evidently means the first vowelled letter of the word, i.e. the sīn of السَّوْء; translated as written.]

farraa:100-100.t:
His saying: ﴿وَٱلسَّابِقُونَ ٱلأَوَّلُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَٱلأَنْصَارِ﴾: if you wish you put الأنصار in the genitive, meaning: of the Emigrants and of the Anṣār. If you wish you put (الأنصار) in the nominative, made to follow His saying (والسابقون). Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī read it so. (والذين أتبعوهم بإحسان): those who did good after them until the Day of Resurrection. (السابقون والذين اتبعوهم) are nominative by the pronoun referring back to them in His saying رضى الله عنهم.
[Translator's note: the sentence «وقد قرأها الحسن البصرىّ» ("al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī read it") is followed in the source directly by the next quotation; it presumably refers to the nominative reading والأنصارُ. The source also has «أتبعوهم» in the first quotation and «اتبعوهم» in the second; reproduced as written.]

farraa:101-101.t:
His saying: ﴿وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ مَرَدُواْ عَلَى ٱلنِّفَاقِ﴾: they became inured to it and persisted in it (marūwū ʿalayhi), as in your saying: tamarradū (they became obstinate).
His saying: ﴿سَنُعَذِّبُهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ﴾: he said: by being killed and by the punishment of the grave.

farraa:102-102.t:
His saying: ﴿خَلَطُواْ عَمَلاً صَالِحاً﴾: He says: they went out to Badr and were present at it. It is also said: the righteous deed is their repentance from staying behind from the campaign of Tabūk.
﴿وَآخَرَ سَيِّئاً﴾: their staying behind on the day of Tabūk. ﴿عَسَى ٱللَّهُ﴾: ʿasā (perhaps) from Allah is binding, if Allah wills. These men had tied themselves to the pillars of the mosque and sworn not to leave that until their repentance was revealed. When it was revealed they said: "O Messenger of Allah, take our wealth in thanks for our repentance." He said: "I will not do so until Qurʾān is revealed to me about that." So Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, revealed His saying: ﴿خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً﴾.

farraa:103-103.t:
His saying: ﴿خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً﴾: so he took part of it.
Then He said: ﴿تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِمْ بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: ask forgiveness for them, for your asking forgiveness for them is something their hearts find rest in, and they are reassured that Allah has accepted their repentance. It has also been read (صلواتك) [in the plural].
The singular al-ṣalāt is more common.
[Translator's note: the source has «استغفر فهم», evidently for «استغفر لهم» ("ask forgiveness for them").]

farraa:106-106.t:
His saying: ﴿وَآخَرُونَ مُرْجَوْنَ لأَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ﴾: they are three named persons who stayed behind from the Prophet ﷺ on the campaign of Tabūk. When he returned he said: "What is your excuse?" They said: "We have no excuse but sin." So they were held in suspense until their repentance was revealed in….
[Translator's note: the sentence breaks off in the source after «فى» ("in").]

farraa:107-107.t:
His saying: ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مَسْجِداً ضِرَاراً﴾: they are Banū ʿAmr ibn ʿAwf of the Anṣār, who built their mosque to rival and harm the mosque of Qubāʾ.
The mosque of Qubāʾ was the first mosque built on piety. When the Prophet ﷺ came back from the campaign of Tabūk, he ordered the mosque of dissension to be burnt and demolished.
[Translator's note: the mosque of ḍirār is usually attributed to a group of hypocrites who built it near Banū ʿAmr ibn ʿAwf, whose own mosque was that of Qubāʾ; the source's wording is translated as it stands.]

farraa:108-108.t:
His saying: ﴿لاَ تَقُمْ فِيهِ أَبَداً﴾ means the mosque of Banū ʿAmr. Then the speech breaks off and He said: ﴿لَّمَسْجِدٌ أُسِّسَ عَلَى ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنْ أَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ أَحَقُّ أَن تَقُومَ فِيهِ﴾. Then He said: (فيه رجال). The first [فيه] is attached as a complement to His saying (تقوم), and the second has put الرجال in the nominative.
His saying: ﴿أُسِّسَ﴾ and (أُسِّسَ) [is also read]; and asās and āsās are permissible. It seems to me that I have heard it in recitation.

farraa:110-110.t: His saying: ﴿لاَ يَزَالُ بُنْيَانُهُمُ﴾ means the mosque of hypocrisy; (رِيبَةً): it is said: doubt. (إلا أن تَقَطَّع) and (تُقَطَّع): its meaning is: unless they die. Al-Ḥasan read (إلى أن تَقَطَّع), in the sense of ḥattā (until), that is: until they are cut to pieces. In the reading of ʿAbdallāh it is (ولو قُطِّعت قلوبُهم), a proof for whoever reads (إلا أن تقطع) with a ḍamma on the tāʾ.

farraa:111-111.t:
His saying: ﴿فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ﴾: [in] the reading of the companions of ʿAbdallāh, they put the passive [lit. the mafʿūl bihi] before the active [lit. the fāʿil]. The reading of the generality is (فَيَقْتُلون ويُقْتَلون).
His saying: ﴿وَعْداً عَلَيْهِ حَقّاً﴾ comes out of His saying: ﴿بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلّجَنَّةَ﴾. It is like your saying: علىَّ ألف درهم عِدّةً صحيحةً ("I owe a thousand dirhams, as a true promise"). The nominative would be permissible if it were said.
[Translator's note: the source has «خاج», evidently a misprint for «خارج» ("comes out of"). The Quranic quotation ﴿فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ﴾ and the "reading of the generality" are printed identically in the source, without vowel distinction of the order; the Ibn Masʿūd/Kufan reading is known as فيُقتَلون ويَقتُلون.]

farraa:112-112.t:
His saying: ﴿ٱلتَّائِبُونَ ٱلْعَابِدُونَ﴾ was begun anew in the nominative because the verse before it is complete and the speech breaks off, so a new beginning (istiʾnāf) is good.
In the reading of ʿAbdallāh it is "التائبين العابدين", in the position of the genitive, because it is an adjective (naʿt) of the believers: He bought from the believers who repent. It is also permissible for (التائبين) to be in the position of the accusative by way of praise (madḥ), as [the poetess] said:
لا يَبْعَدَنْ قومى الذين هُم * سُمّ العُدَاة وآفَةُ الجُزْرِ
النازلين بكل معتَرك * والطيّبينَ معاقِدَ الأزْر
(May my people not perish, who are poison to enemies and a bane to slaughter-camels; who alight in every battle-field, and pure where their waist-wrappers are tied.)

farraa:115-115.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْماً بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَاهُمْ﴾: the Muslims asked the Prophet ﷺ about those Muslims who had died while praying towards the first qibla and holding wine lawful before it was forbidden. They said: "O Messenger of Allah, did our brothers die astray?" So Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, revealed: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْماً بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُبَيِّنَ لَهُم مَّا يَتَّقُونَ﴾. He says: they were not astray, for they had not been turned away from the first qibla, and the prohibition of wine had not been revealed to them.

farraa:117-117.t: His saying: ﴿لَقَدْ تَابَ الله عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَٱلْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَٱلأَنصَارِ﴾, and His saying: ﴿مِن بَعْدِ مَا كَادَ يَزِيغُ﴾ and (كاد تزيغ). [Whoever] says (كاد يزيغ) puts in (كاد يزيِغ) a noun [i.e. an implied subject] like the one in His saying: ﴿عسى أن يكونوا خيرا منهم﴾, and makes (يزيغ), by which القلوب is put in the nominative, masculine; as Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, said: ﴿لن ينالَ اللهَ لحومُهَا﴾ and ﴿لا يحل لك النساء من بعد﴾. Whoever says (تزيغ) makes the verb of the hearts feminine, as He said: ﴿نريد أن نأكل مِنها وتطمئن قلوبنا﴾, and that is the proper form of speech; He did not say (يطمئن). Every verb belonging to a plural, masculine or feminine, you may, if you wish, make feminine when you put it first, and if you wish make masculine.

farraa:118-118.t:
His saying: ﴿وَعَلَى ٱلثَّلاَثَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ خُلِّفُواْ﴾: they are Kaʿb ibn Mālik, Bilāl ibn Umayya and Murāra.
[Translator's note: the source has «بلال بن أمية»; the Companion is usually named Hilāl ibn Umayya.]

farraa:120-120.t: His saying: ﴿وَلاَ يَطَأُونَ مَوْطِئاً﴾: by al-mawṭiʾ He means the land. ﴿ولا يقطعون واديا﴾ in their going and coming, but it is written for them.

farraa:122-122.t:
His saying: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُواْ كَآفَّةً﴾: when the Muslims were reproached for staying behind from the campaign of Tabūk, [and] the Prophet ﷺ began to send out raiding parties, they would all go out together, so that the Prophet ﷺ would be left alone. So Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, revealed: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُواْ كَآفَّةً﴾, meaning: all together, leaving you alone.
Then He said: ﴿فَلَوْلاَ نَفَرَ﴾, its meaning being: why did there not go out ﴿مِن كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ طَآئِفَةٌ﴾, so that those remaining who stayed behind might gain understanding and preserve [and teach] their people what was revealed of the Qurʾān to the Prophet ﷺ.
﴿وَلِيُنذِرُواْ قَوْمَهُمْ﴾: He says: to give them understanding. It has also been said about it that the Bedouins of Asad came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Medina, so prices rose and they filled the roads with filth. So Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, revealed: ﴿فَلَوْلاَ نَفَرَ﴾: He says: why did not a party of them go out, then return to their people and tell them what they had learned?

farraa:123-123.t: His saying: ﴿يَلُونَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ﴾ means: the nearest, then the next nearest.

farraa:124-124.t: His saying: ﴿وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُمْ مَّن يَقُولُ﴾ means the hypocrites; some of them say to others: "Has this increased you in faith?" So Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, revealed: ﴿فأما الذين آمنوا فزادتهم إيمانا...وأما الذين فى قلوبهم مرض فزادتهم رِجْساً إلى رِجسهم﴾. The sickness here is hypocrisy.

farraa:126-126.t:
His saying: ﴿أَوَلاَ يَرَوْنَ﴾, and (ويّروا) with tāʾ. In the reading of ʿAbdallāh: "أو لا ترى أَنهم". The Arabs say أَلا ترى ("do you not see?") to a group and to one person alike, as an expression of wonder; just as it is said "ذلك أزكى لهم" and "ذلكم"; likewise (أَلا ترى) and (الا ترون).
[Translator's note: «ويّروا» appears to be a corrupted spelling of the tāʾ reading «أَوَلا تَرَوْن»; reproduced as written.]

farraa:127-127.t:
His saying: ﴿وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ﴾ in which they were mentioned and their faults [exposed], some of them said to others: ﴿هَلْ يَرَاكُمْ مِّنْ أَحَدٍ﴾ if you stand up [and leave]? Then if it was possible for them to stand up, they stood up.
That is His saying: ﴿ثُمَّ ٱنصَرَفُواْ صَرَفَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُم﴾, an imprecation against them.
[Translator's note: «فإن لهم القيام» is probably for «فإن أمكنهم القيام» ("if standing up was possible for them"); translated in that sense.]

farraa:128-128.t:
His saying: ﴿لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ﴾: He says: there remained no clan of the Arabs but had a share in his birth. That is His saying ﴿مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ﴾.
His saying: ﴿عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ﴾: (ما) is in the position of the nominative; its meaning is: your suffering is grievous to him. Had it been accusative — "عزيزا عليه ما عنتم حريصا رءوفا رحيما" — it would be correct, on the basis of His saying: "there has come to you [a messenger] thus". And al-ḥirṣ (eager concern) is being grudging that they should enter the Fire.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿كيف وإن يظهروا عليكم لا يرقبوا فيكم إلا ولا ذمة﴾: كيف is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī); ﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl), and إن is conditional; يظهروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; لا يرقبوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); فيكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يرقبوا; إلا [Translator's note: i.e. إلًّا, "bond of kinship"] is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ذمة is conjoined to it.
﴿يرضونكم بأفواههم وتأبى قلوبهم وأكثرهم فاسقون﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; بأفواههم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يرضونكم; تأبى قلوبهم is conjoined to it; أكثرهم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and فاسقون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿اشتروا بآيات الله ثمنا قليلا﴾: اشتروا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بآيات is a preposition and its genitive noun; ﴿الله﴾, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ثمنًا is the object of اشتروا, and قليلا is an adjective.
﴿فصدوا عن سبيله إنهم ساء ما كانوا يعملون﴾: ساء is a past verb, and ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e. «ساءهم الذي كانوا يعملونه» (what they used to do grieved them), or «عملهم» (their deed) if you take ما as maṣdariyya. Or بئس [Translator's note: so in the source; ساء is evidently meant] is a frozen (jāmid) verb, one of the verbs of blame, running in the same way as بئس, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿لا يرقبون في مؤمن إلا ولا ذمة﴾: لا is negating; يرقبون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); في مؤمن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرقبون; ﴿إلًّا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ولا ذمة is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to إلًّا.
﴿وأولئك هم المعتدون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أولئك is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is a second mubtadaʾ, and المعتدون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾, the nominal clause being the khabar of the demonstrative. Or هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and المعتدون is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿فإن تابوا وأقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إن is conditional; تابوا is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); وأقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة: the two clauses are conjoined to تابوا.
﴿فإخوانكم في الدين﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); إخوانكم is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «فهم إخوانكم» (then they are your brothers); في الدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause ﴿فإن تابوا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ونفصل الآيات لقوم يعلمون﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause is a parenthesis between the two conditionals, between His words ﴿فإن تابوا﴾ and His words ﴿وإن نكثوا﴾, to arouse and urge reflection on the rulings that Allah the Exalted has set out in detail. Or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive; on both views the clause has no grammatical position. لقوم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نفصل﴾, and the clause يعلمون is an adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وإن نكثوا أيمانهم من بعد عهدهم وطعنوا في دينكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من بعد عهدهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and طعنوا في دينكم is also conjoined.
﴿فقاتلوا أئمة الكفر إنهم لا أيمان لهم لعلهم ينتهون﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); قاتلوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and أئمة الكفر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). إنهم: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; لا is the lā of generic negation, and أيمان is its noun; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of it, and the clause is the khabar of إنهم. لعل is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ينتهون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ألا تقاتلون قوما نكثوا أيمانهم﴾: ألا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); تقاتلون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and قومًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause نكثوا أيمانهم is an adjective (ṣifa) of قومًا. Or the hamza is interrogative and لا is negating, the hamza entering upon it to affirm (taqrīr) the negation of fighting, and urging it from another angle.
﴿وهموا بإخراج الرسول﴾: conjoined to نكثوا; بإخراج is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) هموا.
﴿وهم بدءوكم أول مرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause بدءوكم is the khabar (predicate); أول مرة is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), attached to بدءوكم.
﴿أتخشونهم فالله أحق أن تخشوه إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: the hamza is interrogative. فالله: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and الله is the mubtadaʾ, and أحق is the khabar; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تخشوه﴾ is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿الله﴾, i.e. «خشية الله أحق» (fearing Allah is more worthy). إن is conditional, كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and مؤمنين is the khabar of كنتم; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿قاتلوهم يعذبهم الله بأيديكم﴾: قاتلوهم is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يعذبهم is the answer to the command, made jussive (majzūm) by it.
﴿ويخزهم وينصركم عليهم ويشف صدور قوم مؤمنين﴾: verbs conjoined to يعذبهم.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ويذهب غيظ قلوبهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يذهب غيظ﴾ is a verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun.
﴿ويتوب الله على من يشاء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يتوب الله is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿على من﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتوب; من is a relative noun in the position of genitive; يشاء is a verb and its fāʿil is a pronoun; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject) in the nominative, and عليم حكيم are two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿أم حسبتم أن تتركوا﴾: أم: a disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction meaning بل together with the interrogative hamza, the meaning being ﴿بل أحسبتم ...﴾; حسبتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of حسبتم.
﴿ولما يعلم الله الذين جاهدوا منكم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); لما is a jussive particle conveying expectation, and يعلم is jussive (majzūm) by it; الله is the fāʿil, and الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause جاهدوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position, and منكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولم يتخذوا من دون الله ولا رسوله ولا المؤمنين وليجة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يتخذوا is an imperfect, jussive by لم; من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتخذوا; ولا رسوله is conjoined to الله; وليجة is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والله خبير بما تعملون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and خبير is the khabar (predicate); بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خبير; the clause تعملون is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿والله خبير...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿ما كان للمشركين أن يعمروا مساجد الله﴾: ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; للمشركين is the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان, and أن and what falls within its scope is its postponed noun.
﴿شاهدين على أنفسهم بالكفر﴾: شاهدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in يعمروا; على أنفسهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) شاهدين, and likewise His words بالكفر.
﴿أولئك حبطت أعمالهم وفي النار هم خالدون﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause حبطت أعمالهم is the khabar (predicate); في النار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدون; هم is a mubtadaʾ, and خالدون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿إنما يعمر مساجد الله من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر وأقام الصلاة وآتى الزكاة﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يعمر مساجد الله is an imperfect verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مَن is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of يعمر; the clause آمن is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position, and what comes after it is conjoined to it.
﴿ولم يخش إلا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يخش is jussive (majzūm) by لم, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to من آمن; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فعسى أولئك أن يكونوا من المهتدين﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; عسى is a past verb, one of the verbs of hope; أولئك is the noun of عسى, and أن يكونوا is the khabar (predicate) of عسى; من المهتدين is the khabar of يكونوا.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أجعلتم سقاية الحاج وعمارة المسجد الحرام كمن آمن بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. The hamza is for rebuking, disapproving interrogation; جعلتم سقاية الحاج is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عمارة المسجد الحرام is conjoined to سقاية الحاج. ﴿كمن﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause آمن is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. A muḍāf must be omitted either from the first or from the second so that the two things equated correspond, the implied form being: «أجعلتم أهل سقاية الحاج وعمارة المسجد الحرام كمن آمن» (have you made the people of the giving of drink to the pilgrims and the maintenance of the Sacred Mosque like one who believed), or: «أجعلتم السقاية والعمارة كإيمان من آمن» (have you made the giving of drink and the maintenance like the faith of one who believed), or «كعمل من آمن» (like the deed of one who believed).
﴿وجاهد في سبيل الله لا يستوون عند الله﴾: conjoined to آمن.
﴿والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: a resumption confirming the nullification of the equality, i.e. the two parties are not equal; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause لا يهدي القوم الظالمين is the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿الذين آمنوا وهاجروا وجاهدوا في سبيل الله بأموالهم وأنفسهم أعظم درجة عند الله وأولئك هم الفائزون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position. الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject); آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position, and what comes after it is conjoined to it; أعظم is the khabar (predicate), and درجة is a tamyīz (specification); عند الله, the adverb, is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿وأولئك هم الفائزون﴾ is a clause conjoined to الذين آمنوا.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿يبشرهم ربهم برحمة منه ورضوان وجنات﴾: يبشرهم ربهم is an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); برحمة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يبشرهم; منه is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿ورضوان وجنات﴾ are conjoined to رحمة.
﴿لهم فيها نعيم مقيم﴾: لهم is a fronted khabar (predicate); فيها is a ḥāl (circumstantial); نعيم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and مقيم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿خالدين فيها أبدا﴾: خالدين is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara, circumstantial); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين; أبدًا is an adverb (ẓarf), also attached to خالدين.
﴿إن الله عنده أجر عظيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the adverb is a fronted khabar (predicate), أجر is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and عظيم is an adjective; the nominal clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تتخذوا آباءكم وإخوانكم أولياء﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), a definite-intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ها is for alerting (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. لا is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; آباءكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), إخوانكم is conjoined to it, and أولياء is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن استحبوا الكفر على الإيمان﴾: إن is conditional; استحبوا is a verb and its fāʿil, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); الكفر is the object of استحبوا; على الإيمان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) استحبوا, which includes the meaning of اختاروا (they chose). The clause ﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يتولهم منكم فأولئك هم الظالمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional [noun], mubtadaʾ (subject); يتولهم is the protasis; منكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a pronoun that is a mubtadaʾ; الظالمون is the khabar (predicate) of أولئك or of هم, and the clause is the khabar of أولئك. The clause ﴿ومن يتولهم منكم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿إن الله له ملك السماوات والأرض يحيي ويميت﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), «﴿له﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and «ملك السماوات والأرض» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «يحيي» is a second khabar of «﴿إن﴾», the first khabar being the clause «﴿له ملك السماوات﴾», and «يميت» is conjoined to «يحيي».
﴿وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is negative, «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, «من دون الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), «من» is a connective (ṣila) particle, «ولي» is a postponed mubtadaʾ by position, and «﴿ولا نصير﴾» is conjoined to «﴿من ولي﴾».

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿لقد تاب الله على النبي والمهاجرين والأنصار الذين اتبعوه في ساعة العسرة﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), «تاب الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «على النبي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿تاب﴾», «المهاجرين والأنصار» is conjoined to «النبي», «﴿الذين﴾» is a naʿt (adjective), the clause «اتبعوه» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position, and «في ساعة العسرة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿اتبعوه﴾».
﴿من بعد ما كاد يزيغ قلوب فريق منهم﴾: «من بعد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), to express the severity [of the hardship] and its reaching the utmost limit; the noun of «كاد» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the clause «يزيغ» is [its] khabar (predicate), «قلوب» is the fāʿil, «فريق» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ثم تاب عليهم إنه بهم رءوف رحيم﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction expressing delay (tarākhī), «تاب» is conjoined to the first «تاب», «﴿عليهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تاب»; in «﴿إنه﴾», «إن» is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun, «﴿بهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «رءوف», and «رءوف رحيم» are two khabars of «﴿إن﴾».

muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿وعلى الثلاثة الذين خلفوا﴾: «﴿على الثلاثة﴾» is conjoined to what preceded, «الذين» is an adjective (ṣifa), the clause «خلفوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», a clause with no grammatical position; «خلفوا» is in the form of the verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), i.e. [left behind] from the campaign.
﴿حتى إذا ضاقت عليهم الأرض بما رحبت وضاقت عليهم أنفسهم﴾: «حتى» is a particle of extent (ghāya), «إذا» is an adverb of future time that includes the meaning of condition, the clause «ضاقت» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to it, «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ضاقت», «الأرض» is the fāʿil (agent), and «بما رحبت» means «برحبها» ("with its vastness"), the bāʾ being a preposition of accompaniment and «ما» being maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun).
﴿وظنوا أن لا ملجأ من الله إلا إليه﴾: «ظنوا» is conjoined to «ضاقت», «أن» is lightened from the heavy [«أنّ»], its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause «﴿لا ملجأ...﴾» is its khabar (predicate); «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «ملجأ» is its noun, «من الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar, «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ملجأ».
﴿ثم تاب عليهم ليتوبوا إن الله هو التواب الرحيم﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction, «تاب» is a past verb, «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تاب﴾»; in «﴿ليتوبوا﴾» the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), or the lām of consequence (ʿāqiba), or of outcome (ṣayrūra), i.e. their consequence was repentance; «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, «﴿هو﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «التواب الرحيم» are two khabars of «﴿هو﴾», and the clause «هو التواب» is the khabar of «إن»; or «﴿هو﴾» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and «التواب الرحيم» are two khabars of «﴿إن﴾».

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: «﴿يا﴾» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (naṣb); «ها» is for alerting (tanbīh), «الذين» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿أي﴾», «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», a clause with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source reads «يا حرف نداء، أي: منادى…», where «أي» is the parsed word «أيّ» (not the explanatory «أي» "i.e.").]
﴿اتقوا الله وكونوا مع الصادقين﴾: «اتقوا الله» is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «كونوا» is conjoined to «اتقوا», the wāw is the noun of «كان», and «مع الصادقين» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كونوا».

muyesser-irab:120-120.t:
﴿ما كان لأهل المدينة ومن حولهم من الأعراب أن يتخلفوا عن رسول الله﴾: «ما» is negative, «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, «﴿لأهل المدينة﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان», «مَن» is conjoined to «﴿أهل﴾», «﴿حولهم﴾» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position, «﴿من الأعراب﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), «أن» together with what falls within its scope is the postponed noun of «كان», and «عن رسول الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يتخلفوا﴾».
﴿ولا يرغبوا بأنفسهم عن نفسه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يرغبوا» is accusative (manṣūb) by conjunction, on the view that «﴿لا﴾» is negative, and jussive (majzūm) on the view that «﴿لا﴾» is prohibitive; «﴿بأنفسهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يرغبوا﴾», and «﴿عن نفسه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. they must accompany him in every circumstance.
﴿ذلك بأنهم لا يصيبهم ظمأ ولا نصب ولا مخمصة في سبيل الله﴾: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «بأنهم» is the khabar, «لا يصيبهم ظمأ» is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); «ولا نصب ولا مخمصة» is conjoined to «﴿ظمأ﴾», and «﴿في سبيل الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the hāʾ, or an adjective (ṣifa) of «مخمصة».
﴿ولا يطئون موطئا يغيظ الكفار﴾: «﴿لا يطئون﴾» is conjoined to «﴿لا يصيبهم﴾», «﴿موطئا﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi, or an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «يغيظ الكفار» is an adjective of «﴿موطئًا﴾».
﴿ولا ينالون من عدو نيلا﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and «﴿من عدو﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿ينالون﴾».
﴿إلا كتب لهم به عمل صالح﴾: «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), the clause «كتب» is in the place of an accusative as a ḥāl, the exception being emptied (mufarragh) from the most general of circumstances; «كتب» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿كتب﴾», and likewise «﴿به﴾», «عمل» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «صالح» is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿إن الله لا يضيع أجر المحسنين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause «لا يضيع أجر المحسنين» is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:121-121.t:
﴿ولا ينفقون نفقة صغيرة ولا كبيرة﴾: conjoined to «﴿لا ينالون﴾», and «نفقة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا يقطعون واديا إلا كتب لهم﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿إلا كتب لهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, from the most general of circumstances, as preceded, with no grammatical position, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted, i.e. «عمل صالح» ("a righteous deed"). [Translator's note: in the previous ayah the same construction was described as a ḥāl in the place of an accusative; here it is called resumptive with no grammatical position — translated as written.]
﴿ليجزيهم الله أحسن ما كانوا يعملون﴾: the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), «يجزي» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām, the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿كتب﴾»; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, «﴿الله﴾» is the fāʿil (agent), «﴿أحسن﴾» is the second mafʿūl bihi, or a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. «يجزيهم أحسن جزاء» ("He rewards them with the best reward"). «﴿ما﴾» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), «﴿كانوا﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, and the clause «﴿يعملون﴾» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:122-122.t:
﴿وما كان المؤمنون لينفروا كافة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is negative, «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, «المؤمنون» is its noun; in «﴿لينفروا﴾» the lām is the lām of denial (juḥūd), i.e. for emphasising the negation, and «ينفروا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of denial; the lām and what it governs are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان», and «﴿كافة﴾» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلولا نفر من كل فرقة منهم طائفة ليتفقهوا في الدين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (of eloquent inference), «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e. «هلاّ» ("why not"), «نفر» is a past verb, «﴿من كل فرقة﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿نفر﴾», «منهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿طائفة﴾»; in «﴿ليتفقهوا﴾» the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), «يتفقهوا» is accusative by an implied «أن», the maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نفر», and «في الدين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يتفقهوا﴾». [Translator's note: the source does not explicitly parse «طائفة»; it is the fāʿil of «نفر».]
﴿ولينذروا قومهم إذا رجعوا إليهم لعلهم يحذرون﴾: «﴿ولينذروا﴾» is conjoined to «﴿ليتفقهوا﴾», the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), «قومهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in «﴿إذا رجعوا﴾» the clause «رجعوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [to «إذا»], «﴿إليهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «رجعوا», «لعل» and its noun [follow], and the clause «يحذرون» is its khabar. [Translator's note: the source has «واسهما», evidently a misprint for «واسمها» ("and its noun").]

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿قل إن كان آباؤكم وأبناؤكم وإخوانكم وأزواجكم وعشيرتكم وأموال اقترفتموها وتجارة تخشون كسادها ومساكن ترضونها أحب إليكم من الله ورسوله وجهاد في سبيله﴾: إن is conditional; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; آباؤكم is its noun, and what follows is conjoined to it; أحب is the khabar (predicate) of كان; إليكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial); من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحب; ﴿ورسوله وجهاد في سبيله﴾ is conjoined to the Name of Majesty, i.e. [more beloved] than emigrating to the two of them.
﴿فتربصوا حتى يأتي الله بأمره والله لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); تربصوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); حتى is a particle of limit and genitive; يأتي is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to تربصوا; الله is the fāʿil, and بأمره is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأتي; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين﴾ is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿لقد نصركم الله في مواطن كثيرة﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. The lām is the answer to an omitted oath, قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); نصركم الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); في مواطن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نصركم, and كثيرة is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ويوم حنين إذ أعجبتكم كثرتكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يوم is an adverb (ẓarf) conjoined to His words ﴿في مواطن﴾, so it is attached to what the thing it is conjoined to is attached to, the implied form being «ونصركم يوم حنين» (and He helped you on the day of Ḥunayn). ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, accusative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿يوم حنين﴾; the clause ﴿أعجبتكم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and كثرتكم is the fāʿil.
﴿فلم تغن عنكم شيئا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; تغن is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by لم; شيئًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وضاقت عليكم الأرض بما رحبت﴾: ضاقت is conjoined to what precedes; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضاقت; الأرض is the fāʿil; the bāʾ is a preposition meaning مع (with), and ما is maṣdariyya, on the view that the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «متلبسة برحبها» (together with its vastness), as when you say «دخلت عليه بثياب السفر» (I came in to him in travelling clothes), i.e. clad in them, meaning with travelling clothes.
﴿ثم وليتم مدبرين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; مدبرين is a ḥāl from the tāʾ in وليتم.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿ثم أنزل الله سكينته على رسوله وعلى المؤمنين﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; أنزل الله is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); سكينته is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); على رسوله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; على المؤمنين is conjoined to رسوله.
﴿وأنزل جنودا لم تروها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنزل جنودًا: conjoined to what precedes; the clause لم تروها is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿جنودًا﴾.
﴿وعذب الذين كفروا وذلك جزاء الكافرين﴾: also conjoined; ذلك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and جزاء الكافرين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿ثم يتوب الله من بعد ذلك على من يشاء والله غفور رحيم﴾: conjoined to what precedes, joined with delay; من بعد ذلك is a ḥāl (circumstantial); على من يشاء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتوب; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور رحيم are its two khabars (predicates).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), a definite-intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ها is for alerting (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنما المشركون نجس﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); المشركون نجس are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate).
﴿فلا يقربوا المسجد الحرام﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; لا is prohibitive; يقربوا is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by it; the wāw is the fāʿil; المسجد is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الحرام is an adjective.
﴿بعد عامهم هذا﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقربوا; عامهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); هذا is a naʿt (adjective) of عامهم, or a badal (substitute) from it.
﴿وإن خفتم عيلة فسوف يغنيكم الله من فضله إن شاء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; خفتم is a verb and its fāʿil, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); عيلة is the mafʿūl bihi. فسوف: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and سوف is a particle of the future; يغنيكم الله is an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); من فضله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغنيكم; إن is conditional and شاء is its verb, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. «فسوف يغنيكم» (then He will enrich you).
﴿إن الله عليم حكيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عليم حكيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿قاتلوا الذين لا يؤمنون بالله ولا باليوم الآخر﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. قاتلوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤمنون; ولا باليوم الآخر is conjoined to الله.
﴿ولا يحرمون ما حرم الله ورسوله﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ما is the object of يحرمون, and the clause حرم الله ورسوله is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يدينون دين الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿دين﴾: the maṣdar (verbal noun) of يدينون, so it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or a mafʿūl bihi with يدينون made to include the meaning of يعتقدون (they believe).
﴿من الذين أوتوا الكتاب﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in يدينون, or from the first الذين together with what falls within its scope; the clause أوتوا الكتاب is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position, and الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿حتى يعطوا الجزية عن يد﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and genitive; يعطوا is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to قاتلوا; الجزية is the mafʿūl bihi, and عن يدٍ is a ḥāl.
﴿وهم صاغرون﴾: a second ḥāl; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and صاغرون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وقالت اليهود عزير ابن الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قالت اليهود is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿عزير﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ابن الله﴾ is the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿وقالت اليهود...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وقالت النصارى المسيح ابن الله﴾: a clause conjoined to the one before it; ﴿قالت النصارى﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿المسيح﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿ابن الله﴾ is the khabar; the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ذلك قولهم بأفواههم﴾: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ, and قولهم is the khabar; ﴿بأفواههم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يضاهئون قول الذين كفروا من قبل﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قول is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; من قبل is a ḥāl.
﴿قاتلهم الله أنى يؤفكون﴾: قاتلهم الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; the clause is a supplication (duʿāʾiyya) with no grammatical position. أنى is an interrogative noun meaning كيف (how), in the position of accusative as a fronted ḥāl; يؤفكون is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), i.e. how are they turned away from the truth.

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: «﴿يا﴾» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (naṣb); «ها» is for alerting (tanbīh), «الذين» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿أي﴾», «آمنوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قاتلوا الذين يلونكم من الكفار﴾: «قاتلوا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the clause «يلونكم» is the ṣila of «الذين», a clause with no grammatical position, and «من الكفار» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وليجدوا فيكم غلظة واعلموا أن الله مع المتقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of command, «يجدوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the wāw is the fāʿil, «فيكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يجدوا﴾», «غلظة» is a mafʿūl bihi, «اعلموا» is conjoined to the preceding command, and «أن» together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of «اعلموا»; «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «﴿مع المتقين﴾» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿وإذا ما أنزلت سورة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, «إذا» is an adverb of future time that includes the meaning of condition, «ما» is connective (ṣila), the clause «أنزلت» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to it, and «سورة» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فمنهم من يقول أيكم زادته هذه إيمانا﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa, linking the apodosis), «﴿منهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and «﴿مَن﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); it is a relative noun, or a complete indefinite (nakira tāmma) qualified by the clause «يقول», i.e. «فريق يقول» ("a party who says"); the clause «يقول» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿مَن﴾», with no grammatical position; «أيكم» is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «زادته» is [its] khabar, the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «﴿هذه﴾» is the fāʿil (agent), and «إيمانًا» is a second mafʿūl bihi; the clause «﴿وإذا ما أنزلت...﴾» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأما الذين آمنوا فزادتهم إيمانا وهم يستبشرون﴾: the fāʾ is of ramification (tafrīʿiyya), «﴿أما﴾» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl), «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila of «الذين», a clause with no grammatical position, the fāʾ is connective, «زادتهم» is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of «﴿الذين﴾», and «إيمانًا» is a second mafʿūl bihi or a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿وأما الذين في قلوبهم مرض فزادتهم رجسا إلى رجسهم﴾: «أما» is conjoined to «﴿أما﴾» in the previous ayah, «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «في قلوبهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «مرض» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; in «﴿فزادتهم﴾» the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), the clause «زادتهم» is the khabar of «الذين», «رجسًا» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «إلى رجسهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa), i.e. «مضمومًا إلى رجسهم» ("added to their filth").
﴿وماتوا وهم كافرون﴾: conjoined to «زادتهم»; the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl), and the clause «﴿هم كافرون﴾», made of mubtadaʾ and khabar, is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t:
﴿أولا يرون أنهم يفتنون في كل عام مرة أو مرتين﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval and rebuke, the wāw is a conjunction joining to something implied, «يرون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), «أن» together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of the verb of mental perception (ruʾya qalbiyya), the clause «يفتنون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», «في كل عام» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يفتنون﴾», «مرة» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is its number, «أو» is a conjunction, and «﴿مرتين﴾» is conjoined to «﴿مرة﴾». [Translator's note: the source writes «خبر إن»; the particle in the ayah is «أنّ».]
﴿ثم لا يتوبون ولا هم يذكرون﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction of delay (tarākhī), the clause «لا يتوبون» is conjoined to «يفتنون», the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿هم﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يذكرون» is [its] khabar.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿وإذا ما أنزلت سورة نظر بعضهم إلى بعض﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the clause «نظر بعضهم» is the apodosis (jawāb) of «﴿إذا﴾», with no grammatical position, and «﴿إلى بعض﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿نظر﴾».
﴿هل يراكم من أحد﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative, the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. «قائلين» ("saying"), and the clause of saying is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); «يراكم» is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «من» is a connective (ṣila) particle, and «أحد» is the fāʿil (agent) by position.
﴿ثم انصرفوا صرف الله قلوبهم بأنهم قوم لا يفقهون﴾: «﴿ثم انصرفوا﴾» is conjoined to «﴿نظر بعضهم﴾»; the clause «﴿صرف الله قلوبهم﴾» may validly be informative and circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or performative and supplicatory, in which case it has no grammatical position; «﴿بأنهم﴾» is attached to «صرف», the bāʾ being causal, «﴿أن﴾» is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause «﴿لا يفقهون﴾» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:128-128.t:
﴿لقد جاءكم رسول من أنفسكم﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), «جاءكم رسول» is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent), and «﴿من أنفسكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿عزيز عليه ما عنتم حريص عليكم بالمؤمنين رءوف رحيم﴾: «عزيز» is a second adjective of «رسول», «﴿عليه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «عزيز», and «ما» is maṣdariyya or relative; or «عزيز» is a fronted khabar (predicate) and «﴿ما عنتم﴾», interpreted as a maṣdar, is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause being an adjective of «﴿رسول﴾»; «حريص» is an adjective, «﴿عليكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «حريص», «بالمؤمنين» is attached to «﴿رءوف﴾», and «رءوف رحيم» are two adjectives of «﴿رسول﴾».

muyesser-irab:129-129.t:
﴿فإن تولوا فقل حسبي الله﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «تولوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), «حسبي» is a fronted khabar (predicate), «﴿الله﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (naṣb).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of «لا» and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar. The clause «﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم﴾: «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿توكلت﴾», «﴿هو﴾» is a mubtadaʾ, «رب العرش» is the khabar, and «العظيم» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «العرش».

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿اتخذوا أحبارهم ورهبانهم أربابا من دون الله والمسيح ابن مريم﴾: اتخذوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أحبارهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and رهبانهم is conjoined to أحبارهم; أربابًا is the second mafʿūl bihi; من دون الله is an adjective (ṣifa) of أربابًا; المسيح is conjoined to أحبارهم, and the second object in relation to it is omitted, i.e. «ربًّا» (a lord); ابن is an adjective of المسيح, or a badal (substitute) from it.
﴿وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا إلها واحدا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); ما is negating; أمروا is a past verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the lām is causal (taʿlīl); يعبدوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal lām, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمروا﴾; إلهًا is the object of يعبدوا, and واحدًا is an adjective of ﴿إلهًا﴾.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: a badal from the position of لا with its noun, since its position is nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is a second adjective of إلهًا.
﴿سبحانه عما يشركون﴾: سبحانه: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); عما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سبحانه; the clause يشركون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿يريدون أن يطفئوا نور الله بأفواههم﴾: the clause يريدون is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أن and what falls within its scope is the object of يريدون; نور الله is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بأفواههم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يطفئوا.
﴿ويأبى الله إلا أن يتم نوره ولو كره الكافرون﴾: يأبى الله is conjoined to يريدون; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), because the speech is on the supposition of negation, since يأبى runs in the same way as لم يُرِد (did not want); أن and what falls within its scope is the object of يأبى. ولو: the wāw is circumstantial, and لو is conditional, its apodosis (jawāb) omitted because what precedes indicates it, its implied form being «لأتمه ولم يبال بكراهتهم» (He would complete it and not mind their dislike); the clause is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause أرسل رسوله is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; بالهدى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسل; دين الحق is conjoined to الهدى.
﴿ليظهره على الدين كله ولو كره المشركون﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); يظهر is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to أرسل; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) referring to the Messenger; على الدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يظهره; كله is a tawkīd (emphasis) of الدين. The wāw is circumstantial and لو is a conditional of linkage (waṣliyya); كره المشركون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, i.e. «ذلك» (that).

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), a definite-intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ها is for alerting (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن كثيرا من الأحبار والرهبان ليأكلون أموال الناس بالباطل﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and كثيرا is its noun; ﴿من الأحبار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of كثيرًا; الرهبان is conjoined to الأحبار. ليأكلون: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the clause يأكلون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; أموال الناس is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالباطل is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويصدون عن سبيل الله﴾: conjoined to يأكلون.
﴿والذين يكنزون الذهب والفضة ولا ينفقونها في سبيل الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يكنزون is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; الذهب is the object of يكنزون, and الفضة is conjoined to الذهب; ولا ينفقونها is conjoined to يكنزون; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينفقونها.
﴿فبشرهم بعذاب أليم﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), on account of the meaning of generality and the flavour of a condition in the condition [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably "in the mubtadaʾ (the relative noun)" is meant]; بشرهم is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; بعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بشرهم, and أليم is an adjective; the clause بشرهم is the khabar. Or الذين is accusative on the implied form «بشر الذين يكنزون» (give tidings to those who hoard). The clause ﴿والذين يكنزون الذهب...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿يوم يحمى عليها في نار جهنم فتكوى بها جباههم وجنوبهم وظهورهم﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, indicated by ﴿عذاب﴾ in His words ﴿بعذاب أليم﴾, the implied form being «يُعذَّبون يوم يُحمى» (they will be punished on the day it is heated); or it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر يوم يحمى» (remember the day it is heated). The clause ﴿يحمى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The omitted nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the Fire, its implied form being «يوم تحمى النار عليها» (the day the Fire is heated over it); when the nāʾib fāʿil was omitted, the feminine marker went away with it. عليها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحمى; في نار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحمى, and جهنم is muḍāf ilayhi. فتكوى: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and تكوى is conjoined to تحمى; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تكوى; جباههم is the nāʾib fāʿil, and جنوبهم وظهورهم are conjoined to جباههم.
﴿هذا ما كنزتم لأنفسكم﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. «يقال لهم» (it will be said to them); هذا is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ما is its khabar (predicate); the clause كنزتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; لأنفسكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كنزتم.
﴿فذوقوا ما كنتم تكنزون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; ذوقوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ما is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause كنتم تكنزون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the clause تكنزون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿إن عدة الشهور عند الله اثنا عشر شهرا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); عدة is its noun, and الشهور is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); عند الله is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. in His ruling; ﴿اثنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن, nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif because it is dual; عشر is a numeral component, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; شهرًا is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿في كتاب الله يوم خلق السماوات والأرض﴾: في كتاب الله is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿اثنا عشر﴾; يوم is an adverb attached to something omitted, or to كتاب الله if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun). It has been said: يوم خلق is a badal (substitute) from His words عند الله, the implied form being: «إن عدة الشهور عند الله في كتاب الله يوم خلق السماوات والأرض». The clause خلق is what the adverb is put in construct with.
﴿منها أربعة حرم﴾: منها is a fronted khabar, أربعة is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and حرم is an adjective; the clause is a second adjective of ﴿اثنا عشر شهرًا﴾.
﴿ذلك الدين القيم﴾: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ, الدين is the khabar, and القيم is an adjective.
﴿فلا تظلموا فيهن أنفسكم﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; لا is prohibitive; تظلموا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); فيهن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تظلموا; أنفسكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وقاتلوا المشركين كافة كما يقاتلونكم كافة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قاتلوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; المشركين is the mafʿūl bihi; كافة is a ḥāl from the fāʿil or the mafʿūl, and it is originally a maṣdar meaning «جميعًا» (all together). ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, the implied form being: «قاتلوا المشركين كافة قتالا مثلَ قتالهم لكم كافة» (fight the polytheists all together with fighting like their fighting of you all together); the clause ﴿يقاتلونكم﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the imperfect verb is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿واعلموا أن الله مع المتقين﴾: أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; أن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿إنما النسيء زيادة في الكفر﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); النسيء is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and زيادة is the khabar (predicate); في الكفر is attached to (mutaʿalliq) زيادة.
﴿يضل به الذين كفروا﴾: يضل is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), nominative; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضل; الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); كفروا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is a second khabar of النسيء.
﴿يحلونه عاما ويحرمونه عاما﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of كفروا, or it is explicative (tafsīriyya) of the misguidance, and so has no grammatical position. عامًا: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿يحلونه﴾. ﴿ويحرمونه عاما﴾: conjoined to ﴿يحلونه عاما﴾.
﴿ليواطئوا عدة ما حرم الله﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and together with its interpreted genitive it is attached to ﴿يحرمونه﴾ or to ﴿يحلونه﴾, according to the rule of contention (tanāzuʿ); عدة is its object; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative [noun], muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause حرم الله is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فيحلوا ما حرم الله﴾: conjoined to ليواطئوا; ما is the object of يحلوا.
﴿زين لهم سوء أعمالهم﴾: the clause is circumstantial from the fāʿil, i.e. «مزينين» (made to find it fair), or resumptive with no grammatical position; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to زين; سوء أعمالهم is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿والله لا يهدي القوم الكافرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يهدي is the khabar; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), a definite-intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ها is for alerting (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿ما لكم إذا قيل لكم انفروا في سبيل الله اثاقلتم إلى الأرض﴾: ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and لكم is the khabar (predicate); إذا is a future adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) اثاقلتم; قيل: a past verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), and لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it; انفروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انفروا; the clause اثاقلتم is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and إلى الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اثاقلتم.
﴿أرضيتم بالحياة الدنيا من الآخرة﴾: the hamza is interrogative; رضيتم is a verb and its fāʿil; بالحياة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رضيتم, and الدنيا is an adjective; من الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. «بديلا من الآخرة» (in exchange for the Hereafter).
﴿فما متاع الحياة الدنيا في الآخرة إلا قليل﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; ما is negating; متاع is a mubtadaʾ, الحياة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الدنيا is an adjective; في الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. «محسوبًا في جنب الآخرة» (reckoned beside the Hereafter), or attached to قليل; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and قليل is the khabar of متاع.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿إلا تنفروا يعذبكم عذابا أليما ويستبدل قوما غيركم﴾: إن is conditional, and لا is negating; تنفروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and يعذبكم is its apodosis (jawāb); عذابًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), since it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), and أليمًا is an adjective (ṣifa); يستبدل is conjoined to يعذبكم; قومًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and غيركم is an adjective of ﴿قومًا﴾.
﴿ولا تضروه شيئا والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: لا تضروه is conjoined to يستبدل; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; شيئًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. «شيئًا من الضرر» (any harm); الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and قدير is its khabar (predicate); على كل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قدير.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إلا تنصروه فقد نصره الله﴾: إن is conditional, and لا is negating; تنصروه is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and the clause قد نصره الله is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿إذ أخرجه الذين كفروا ثاني اثنين﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نصره الله﴾; the clause ﴿أخرجه﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb being put in construct with it; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿ثاني اثنين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in أخرجه.
﴿إذ هما في الغار﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a badal (substitute) from the ﴿إذ﴾ in His words ﴿إذ أخرجه﴾; هما is a mubtadaʾ (subject); في الغار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿هما في الغار﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إذ يقول لصاحبه لا تحزن إن الله معنا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a badal from the ﴿إذ﴾ in His words ﴿إذ هما في الغار﴾; the clause ﴿يقول﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿لا تحزن﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿معنا﴾ is an adverb attached to the omitted khabar of إن, and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿إن الله معنا﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).
﴿فأنزل الله سكينته عليه وأيده بجنود لم تروها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أنزل الله سكينته is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل; أيده is conjoined to أنزل; بجنود is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أيده; the clause لم تروها is an adjective (ṣifa) of جنود.
﴿وجعل كلمة الذين كفروا السفلى وكلمة الله هي العليا﴾: the wāw is also a conjunction; جعل is a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah; كلمة is the mafʿūl bihi, and الذين is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; السفلى is the second mafʿūl bihi of جعل. وكلمة: the wāw is circumstantial; كلمة الله is a mubtadaʾ; هي is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) or a mubtadaʾ; العليا is the khabar of كلمة, or the khabar of هي, the clause being the khabar of كلمة.
﴿والله عزيز حكيم﴾: الله is a mubtadaʾ, and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿انفروا خفافا وثقالا وجاهدوا بأموالكم وأنفسكم في سبيل الله﴾: انفروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); خفافًا وثقالًا are two ḥāls (circumstantials); جاهدوا is conjoined to انفروا; بأموالكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهدوا; أنفسكم is conjoined to بأموالكم; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to جاهدوا.
﴿ذلكم خير لكم إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: ذلكم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and خير is the khabar (predicate); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير; إن is conditional, and كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause تعلمون is the khabar of كنتم; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. «فجاهدوا» (then strive), or «فلا تثاقلوا» (then do not be sluggish).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿لو كان عرضا قريبا وسفرا قاصدا لاتبعوك﴾: لو is a conditional of impossibility (imtināʿiyya). كان عرضًا: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being الشأن (the matter), i.e. what they were called to; عرضًا is its khabar (predicate), and سفرًا قاصدًا is conjoined to it. لاتبعوك: the lām occurs in the answer to لو; اتبعوك is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن بعدت عليهم الشقة﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative (muhmal) because it is lightened; بعدت عليهم الشقة is a verb and its fāʿil; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بعدت﴾; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿وسيحلفون بالله لو استطعنا لخرجنا معكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the sīn is for the future; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحلفون﴾; the clause لو استطعنا is the answer to the oath, and the clause لخرجنا is the answer to لو. Or the clause ﴿لو استطعنا﴾ is the object of an omitted saying, accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «قائلين» (saying), and ﴿لخرجنا﴾ stands in place of [the answers to] both the oath and the condition together; ﴿معكم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to خرجنا.
﴿يهلكون أنفسهم والله يعلم إنهم لكاذبون﴾: the clause يهلكون أنفسهم is a badal (substitute) from سيحلفون, or a ḥāl, i.e. «مهلكين» (destroying); أنفسهم is the mafʿūl bihi; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يعلم is the khabar; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and ﴿كاذبون﴾ is its khabar; the clause ﴿إنهم لكاذبون﴾ stands in place of the two objects of يعلم.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿عفا الله عنك لم أذنت لهم﴾: a clause of supplication (duʿāʾiyya). لِمَ: the lām is a preposition which has entered upon the interrogative ما, so its alif was dropped. Both lāms are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the permitting, since they differ in meaning: the first is causal (taʿlīl) and the second is for conveying (tablīgh); the genitive pronoun is for all of those who asked permission.
﴿حتى يتبين لك الذين صدقوا وتعلم الكاذبين﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and genitive; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتبين; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause صدقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; تعلم is conjoined to يتبين, and الكاذبين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿لا يستأذنك الذين يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: the resumptive clause; يستأذنك is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤمنون; اليوم الآخر is conjoined to الله.
