﴿أن يجاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم والله عليم بالمتقين﴾: أن and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «في الجهاد» (for striving), and it is attached to يستأذنك; بأموالهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجاهدوا; أنفسهم is conjoined to أموالهم; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and عليم is the khabar (predicate); بالمتقين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. The clause ﴿لا يستأذنك الذين...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿إنما يستأذنك الذين لا يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يستأذنك is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤمنون; اليوم الآخر is conjoined to الله.
﴿وارتابت قلوبهم فهم في ريبهم يترددون﴾: conjoined to لا يؤمنون; ارتابت قلوبهم is a verb and its fāʿil. فهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); في ريبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يترددون, and the clause يترددون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿ولو أرادوا الخروج لأعدوا له عدة﴾: conjoined speech, or resumptive with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; أرادوا الخروج is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām occurs in the answer to لو; أعدوا is a verb and its fāʿil; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعدوا; عدة is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولكن كره الله انبعاثهم﴾: the wāw is conjoining to something omitted, as though it were said: «ما خرجوا ولكن كره الله انبعاثهم» (they did not go out, but Allah disliked their setting forth).
﴿فثبطهم وقيل اقعدوا مع القاعدين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ثبطهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi. قيل: a past verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), because the speaker may possibly refer to Allah, and may possibly refer to the wretchedness and evil end fixed in their souls; اقعدوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; مع is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to اقعدوا, and القاعدين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿لو خرجوا فيكم ما زادوكم إلا خبالا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; خرجوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); فيكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خرجوا; the clause ما زادوكم has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to a non-jussive condition; زادوكم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and خبالا is the second mafʿūl bihi; the exception here is connected (muttaṣil), not disconnected (munqaṭiʿ).
﴿ولأوضعوا خلالكم يبغونكم الفتنة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لأوضعوا is conjoined to ما زادوكم, and the lām occurs in the answer to لو; خلالكم is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), attached to أوضعوا, i.e. they would have run about among you with tale-bearing and incitement; the clause يبغونكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of أوضعوا, i.e. they would have hastened among you seeking your discord; الفتنة is the object of يبغونكم, and the kāf is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «يبغون لكم الفتنة» (seeking discord for you).
﴿وفيكم سماعون لهم والله عليم بالظالمين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); فيكم is a fronted khabar (predicate), and سماعون is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سماعون; الله is a mubtadaʾ and عليم is the khabar; بالظالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿لقد ابتغوا الفتنة من قبل وقلبوا لك الأمور﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; ابتغوا الفتنة is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ابتغوا, and [قبل] is made indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from the construct in wording but not in meaning, i.e. before the expedition of Tabūk; وقلبوا لك الأمور: conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿حتى جاء الحق وظهر أمر الله وهم كارهون﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and genitive; جاء الحق is a verb and its fāʿil; ظهر أمر الله is also a verb and its fāʿil. وهم كارهون: the wāw is circumstantial, and هم كارهون are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), the clause being accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿ومنهم من يقول ائذن لي ولا تفتني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; منهم is a fronted khabar (predicate), and من is a relative [noun], a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يقول is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; ائذن is a verb of request, and لي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; the wāw is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, تفتني is jussive (majzūm) by لا, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ألا في الفتنة سقطوا﴾: ألا is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); في الفتنة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سقطوا.
﴿وإن جهنم لمحيطة بالكافرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and جهنم is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); محيطة is the khabar of إن; بالكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to محيطة. The speech is conjoined to the preceding clause and falls within the scope of the alerting.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿إن تصبك حسنة تسؤهم﴾: إن is conditional; تصبك is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and حسنة is the fāʿil (agent); تسؤهم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وإن تصبك مصيبة يقولوا قد أخذنا أمرنا من قبل﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿ويتولوا وهم فرحون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and يتولوا is conjoined to يقولوا; the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl), and هم فرحون are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is a ḥāl from the two pronouns in يقولوا and يتولوا, not from the last only, since the rejoicing accompanies both together.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿قل لن يصيبنا إلا ما كتب الله لنا﴾: the clause لن يصيبنا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ما is the fāʿil (agent); the clause كتب الله لنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿هو مولانا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الله.
﴿وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīl); على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتوكل; the lām is the lām of command, يتوكل is jussive (majzūm) by the lām, and المؤمنون is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿قل هل تربصون بنا إلا إحدى الحسنيين﴾: هل is an interrogative particle; تربصون is an imperfect verb, one of its two tāʾs having been dropped, i.e. «تنتظرون» (you wait); بنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تربصون; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and إحدى الحسنيين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ونحن نتربص أن يصيبكم الله بعذاب من عنده أو بأيدينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or circumstantial; نحن is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause نتربص is the khabar (predicate); بكم [Translator's note: the word بكم, which is in the ayah, is omitted from the quoted heading] is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نتربص; أن and what falls within its scope is a mafʿūl bihi; الله is the fāʿil (agent); بعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصيبكم; من عنده is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب; أو بأيدينا is conjoined to من عنده, i.e. «بعذاب بأيدينا» (with a punishment at our hands).
﴿فتربصوا إنا معكم متربصون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; تربصوا is an imperative verb; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; معكم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to متربصون, and متربصون is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿قل أنفقوا طوعا أو كرها﴾: the clause أنفقوا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); طوعًا وكرهًا are two maṣdars (verbal nouns) made accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «طائعين أو مكرهين» (willingly or unwillingly).
﴿لن يتقبل منكم إنكم كنتم قوما فاسقين﴾: لن is a particle of negation, accusative and future; يتقبل, built as passive (for one whose agent is not named), is an imperfect, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتقبل﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and قوما is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the khabar of إن, and فاسقين is an adjective (ṣifa) of قومًا.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿وما منعهم أن تقبل منهم نفقاتهم إلا أنهم كفروا بالله وبرسوله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating; منعهم is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن تقبل﴾: أن and what falls within its scope is the second object of منع; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقبل; نفقاتهم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and أن and what falls within its scope is the fāʿil (agent) of منع, i.e. nothing at all prevented them from the acceptance of their spendings except their disbelief and what is conjoined to it.
﴿ولا يأتون الصلاة إلا وهم كسالى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating; يأتون الصلاة is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of restriction; هم كسالى are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl), and the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿ولا ينفقون إلا وهم كارهون﴾: conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿فلا تعجبك أموالهم ولا أولادهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; تعجبك is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت (you), and أموالهم is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source, which names two agents; أموالهم is the agent, and the kāf (you) is the object]; ولا أولادهم is conjoined to it.
﴿إنما يريد الله ليعذبهم بها في الحياة الدنيا﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يريد الله is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ليعذبهم﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); يعذبهم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal lām; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being هو (He); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the plural marker; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يريد﴾; the object of يريد is omitted, i.e. He wants to give to them in order to punish them. Or the lām in ﴿ليعذبهم﴾ is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant], and يعذبهم: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied maṣdariyya أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يعذبهم﴾ is the object of يريد, the implied form being: «يريد الله تعذيبهم» (Allah wants their punishment). ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعذبهم﴾, and ﴿في الحياة الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وتزهق أنفسهم وهم كافرون﴾: ﴿تزهق﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ليعذبهم﴾; أنفسهم is the fāʿil; the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and كافرون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿ويحلفون بالله إنهم لمنكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿يحلفون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحلفون﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿وما هم منكم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating [ما], operating like ليس; ﴿هم﴾ is the noun of ما, and ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ما. Or ﴿ما﴾ is negating without effect; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿ولكنهم قوم يفرقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; قوم is its khabar, and the clause يفرقون is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿لو يجدون ملجأ أو مغارات أو مدخلا لولوا إليه وهم يجمحون﴾: لو is conditional; يجدون ملجأ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أو مغارات أو مدخلا are conjoined to ملجأ. لولوا: the lām occurs in the answer to لو; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ولوا. وهم: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يجمحون is the khabar (predicate), the clause being circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause لولوا has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿ومنهم من يلمزك في الصدقات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; منهم is a fronted khabar (predicate), and من is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يلمزك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; في الصدقات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يلمزك.
﴿فإن أعطوا منها رضوا وإن لم يعطوا منها إذا هم يسخطون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is conditional; أعطوا is a past verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); منها is in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because the wāw, which is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), is its first object; وإن لم يعطوا منها is conjoined to the first clause; إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); هم is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يسخطون is the khabar; the clause إذا هم يسخطون is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because ﴿إذا﴾ takes the place of the fāʾ.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿ولو أنهم رضوا ما آتاهم الله ورسوله﴾: أن and what falls within its scope is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, i.e. «لو ثبت رضاهم» (if their contentment were established); ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause آتاهم الله ورسوله is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقالوا حسبنا الله سيؤتينا الله من فضله ورسوله﴾: حسبنا is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and الله the khabar (predicate), or the reverse, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); سيؤتينا الله is an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; من فضله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤتينا; رسوله is conjoined to الله.
﴿إنا إلى الله راغبون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿راغبون﴾, and راغبون is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿إنما الصدقات للفقراء والمساكين والعاملين عليها والمؤلفة قلوبهم﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); الصدقات is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and للفقراء is the khabar (predicate); المساكين is conjoined to الفقراء; العاملين عليها is also conjoined; المؤلفة قلوبهم is also conjoined to what precedes, and قلوبهم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وفي الرقاب والغارمين وفي سبيل الله وابن السبيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; في الرقاب is conjoined to His words للفقراء, i.e. «ومصروفة في الرقاب» (and spent on the necks), and a muḍāf must be implied, i.e. «وفي فك الرقاب» (and in freeing the necks); الغارمين is also conjoined; في سبيل الله is also conjoined, i.e. those undertaking jihad; ابن السبيل is also conjoined.
﴿فريضة من الله والله عليم حكيم﴾: فريضة is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), a maṣdar (verbal noun) confirming the content of the preceding clause, i.e. «فرض ذلك فريضة» (that has been ordained as an obligation); من الله is an adjective (ṣifa); الله is a mubtadaʾ, عليم is a first khabar, and حكيم is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿ومنهم الذين يؤذون النبي﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; منهم is a fronted khabar (predicate), and الذين is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يؤذون النبي is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويقولون هو أذن قل أذن خير لكم﴾: يقولون is conjoined to يؤذون; the clause هو أذن, made of the mubtadaʾ and the khabar, is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); قل is an imperative verb; أذن is a khabar whose mubtadaʾ is omitted; خير is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أذن.
﴿يؤمن بالله ويؤمن للمؤمنين﴾: يؤمن: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). بالله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمن﴾. ويؤمن للمؤمنين: conjoined to يؤمن بالله. The clause ﴿يؤمن بالله﴾ is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ, or a second naʿt of أذن, or explicative (tafsīriyya), explaining his being an ear of good for them, and so it has no grammatical position.
﴿ورحمة للذين آمنوا منكم﴾: conjoined to أذن خير; للذين آمنوا is an adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة; منكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in آمنوا.
﴿والذين يؤذون رسول الله لهم عذاب أليم﴾: الذين is a mubtadaʾ; the clause يؤذون رسول الله is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; لهم is a fronted khabar, عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and أليم is an adjective; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿يحلفون بالله لكم ليرضوكم﴾: the clause is a second khabar (predicate) of الذين; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يحلفون; the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and يرضوكم is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to يحلفون; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿والله ورسوله أحق أن يرضوه إن كانوا مؤمنين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (for the ḥāl); الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and رسوله is conjoined to الله; أحق is a fronted khabar, and أن and what falls within its scope is a postponed mubtadaʾ, the nominal clause being the khabar of الله; إن is conditional, كانوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and مؤمنين is the khabar of كانوا; the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, i.e. «فالله ورسوله أحق» (then Allah and His Messenger are more worthy). It has been said: the speech is two clauses, the khabar of one of them omitted because the second indicates it, the implied form being: «والله أحق أن يرضوه ورسوله كذلك» (Allah is more worthy that they should please Him, and His Messenger likewise).

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿ألم يعلموا أنه من يحادد الله ورسوله﴾: the hamza is for rebuking, disapproving interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يعلموا is jussive (majzūm) by لم; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of يعلموا; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; من is a conditional [noun], mubtadaʾ (subject); يحادد is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the Name of Majesty is its object, and رسوله is conjoined to the lām [Translator's note: so in the source; "to the Name of Majesty" (لفظ الجلالة) is evidently meant].
﴿فأن له نار جهنم خالدا فيها ذلك الخزي العظيم﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); أن is an abrogating particle; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and نار جهنم is its postponed noun; خالدًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun made genitive by the lām; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خالدًا﴾; the clause of the conditional noun, its verb and its apodosis is the khabar of the first ﴿أنه﴾; ذلك is a mubtadaʾ, الخزي is its khabar, and العظيم is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿يحذر المنافقون أن تنزل عليهم سورة تنبئهم بما في قلوبهم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; يحذر المنافقون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن تنزل عليهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) made accusative by يحذر, for it is transitive by itself; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنزل; سورة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause تنبئهم is an adjective (ṣifa) of سورة; بما is in the place of the second object of تنبئهم; في قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿قل استهزئوا إن الله مخرج ما تحذرون﴾: استهزئوا is an imperative verb; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and مخرج is its khabar (predicate); ما is a relative [noun], the object of مخرج, since it is an active participle; the clause تحذرون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿ولئن سألتهم ليقولن إنما كنا نخوض﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); إن: conditional; سألتهم: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ليقولن: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; يقولن is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the doubled nūn is for emphasis (tawkīd); the clause إنما كنا نخوض ونلعب is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause نخوض is the khabar (predicate) of كنا.
﴿قل أبالله وآياته ورسوله كنتم تستهزئون﴾: the hamza is for rebuking, disapproving interrogation; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تستهزئون; آياته ورسوله are conjoined to the Name of Majesty; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the verbal clause is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿لا تعتذروا قد كفرتم بعد إيمانكم﴾: لا is prohibitive; تعتذروا is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كفرتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بعد is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) كفرتم, and إيمانكم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إن نعف عن طائفة منكم نعذب طائفة بأنهم كانوا مجرمين﴾: إن is conditional; نعف is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); عن طائفة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نعف; منكم is an adjective (ṣifa); نعذب is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and طائفة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بأنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نعذب, the bāʾ being causal; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause كانوا مجرمين is its khabar (predicate); كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and مجرمين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿المنافقون والمنافقات بعضهم من بعض﴾: المنافقون is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and المنافقات is conjoined to it; بعضهم is a mubtadaʾ, and من بعض is the khabar (predicate).
﴿يأمرون بالمنكر وينهون عن المعروف ويقبضون أيديهم﴾: the clause is a second khabar of ﴿لمنافقون﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; ﴿المنافقون﴾ is meant], the first being the nominal clause; وينهون عن المعروف is conjoined to the preceding clause, and ويقبضون أيديهم is also conjoined.
﴿نسوا الله فنسيهم إن المنافقين هم الفاسقون﴾: نسوا الله is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فنسيهم is conjoined to نسوا; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and المنافقين is its noun; هم is a second mubtadaʾ, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); الفاسقون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾ or the khabar of إن, and the nominal clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿وعد الله المنافقين والمنافقات والكفار نار جهنم﴾: وعد الله المنافقين is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; المنافقات is conjoined, and likewise الكفار; نار جهنم is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿خالدين فيها هي حسبهم﴾: خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first object; ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and حسبهم is the khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿ولعنهم الله ولهم عذاب مقيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لعنهم الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; لهم is a fronted khabar, عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and مقيم is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿كالذين من قبلكم كانوا أشد منكم قوة﴾: ﴿كالذين﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «أنتم مثلُ الذين من قبلكم» (you are like those before you); الذين: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من قبلكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and أشد is its khabar; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أشد; قوة is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿وأكثر أموالا وأولادا﴾: conjoined to أشد منكم قوة.
﴿فاستمتعوا بخلاقهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; استمتعوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بخلاقهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استمتعوا.
﴿فاستمتعتم بخلاقكم﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿كما استمتع الذين من قبلكم بخلاقهم﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: «استمتعتم بخلاقكم استمتاعًا مثلَ استمتاع الذين من قبلكم» (you enjoyed your portion with an enjoyment like the enjoyment of those before you); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿استمتع﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause ﴿استمتع﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿استمتع﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من قبلكم﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بخلاقهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استمتع.
﴿وخضتم كالذي خاضوا﴾: ﴿خضتم﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿كالذي﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: «وخضتم خوضًا مثلَ خوض الذين خاضوا» (you plunged with a plunging like the plunging of those who plunged).
﴿أولئك حبطت أعمالهم في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause حبطت is the khabar; أعمالهم is the fāʿil; في الدنيا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حبطت.
﴿وأولئك هم الخاسرون﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿ألم يأتهم نبأ الذين من قبلهم﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (taqrīr); لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يأتهم is jussive (majzūm) by لم; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and نبأ is the fāʿil (agent); الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and من قبلهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿قوم نوح وعاد وثمود وقوم إبراهيم وأصحاب مدين والمؤتفكات﴾: قوم is a badal (substitute) from الذين, a substitute of part for whole; His words وعاد to the end of the conjoined items are all conjoined to قوم نوح, except that the last, namely المؤتفكات, is on the omission of a muḍāf.
﴿أتتهم رسلهم بالبينات﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, and رسله [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the ayah is رسلهم] is the fāʿil.
﴿فما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ما is negating. كان الله: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the lām is the lām of denial (juḥūd); يظلمون [Translator's note: so in the source; يظلم (in ليظلمهم) is meant] is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of denial; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), i.e. «مريدًا لظلمهم» (intending to wrong them). ﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لكن﴾ is lightened and inoperative (mukhaffafa muhmala); كانوا is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun; أنفسهم is a fronted object of يظلمون, and the clause يظلمون is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿والمؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أولياء بعض﴾: المؤمنون is a mubtadaʾ (subject); بعضهم is a second mubtadaʾ, and أولياء is the khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of المؤمنون.
﴿يأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر﴾: the first clause is a second khabar of ﴿المؤمنون﴾, the first being the nominal clause; وينهون عن المنكر is conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿ويقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿ويطيعون الله ورسوله﴾: also conjoined.
﴿أولئك سيرحمهم الله إن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause سيرحمهم الله is the khabar; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وعد الله المؤمنين والمؤمنات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: وعد الله المؤمنين is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جنات is the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause تجري is an adjective (ṣifa); الأنهار is the fāʿil; من تحتها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري.
﴿خالدين فيها ومساكن طيبة في جنات عدن﴾: خالدين فيها is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from المؤمنين; مساكن is conjoined to جنات, and طيبة is an adjective; في جنات عدن is a second adjective.
﴿ورضوان من الله أكبر﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) with which it is permissible to begin because it is qualified by His words من الله; أكبر is its khabar (predicate).
﴿ذلك هو الفوز العظيم﴾: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ; هو is a second mubtadaʾ, and الفوز is the khabar of هو; and the clause [is] the demonstrative [Translator's note: so in the source; "the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative" is evidently meant]; العظيم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي جاهد الكفار والمنافقين﴾: جاهد is an imperative verb; الكفار is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and المنافقين is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الكفار.
﴿واغلظ عليهم﴾: اغلظ is conjoined to جاهد.
﴿ومأواهم جهنم وبئس المصير﴾: the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied sense being: do that while they deserve Hell, that state being the state of their disbelief and hypocrisy. Or the wāw is brought to alert to the intention of an omitted verb, its implied form being: «واعلم أن جهنم مأواهم» (and know that Hell is their refuge). Or the speech is construed according to the meaning, the meaning being that the punishment of this world through jihad and harshness and the punishment of the Hereafter through making Hell their refuge have been combined for them. It has been said: the wāw is resumptive. وبئس المصير: the wāw is a conjunction, and بئس المصير is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being جهنم; the clause ﴿وبئس المصير﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿يحلفون بالله ما قالوا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يحلفون; ما is negating; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ما قالوا﴾ is the answer to the oath.
﴿ولقد قالوا كلمة الكفر وكفروا بعد إسلامهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and كلمة الكفر is the object; كفروا is conjoined to قالوا; بعد is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to كفروا.
﴿وهموا بما لم ينالوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to هموا; the clause ﴿لم ينالوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما نقموا إلا أن أغناهم الله ورسوله من فضله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating; نقموا is a verb and its fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); أن and what falls within its scope is the object of نقموا; أغناهم الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil; رسوله is conjoined to الله; من فضله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أغناهم.
﴿فإن يتوبوا يك خيرا لهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is conditional; يتوبوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); يك is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the sukūn on the nūn, which is dropped for lightness; the noun of يك is latent (mustatir), i.e. the repenting; خيرًا is the khabar (predicate); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾.
﴿وإن يتولوا يعذبهم الله عذابا أليما في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is conditional; يتولوا is the protasis, and يعذبهم is the apodosis; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and الله is the fāʿil; عذابا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), since it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), and أليمًا is an adjective (ṣifa); في الدنيا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعذبهم, and الآخرة is conjoined to الدنيا.
﴿وما لهم في الأرض من ولي ولا نصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating; لهم is a fronted khabar; في الأرض is a ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila) particle [i.e. redundant]; ولي is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) by position; ولا نصير is conjoined to ولي.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ومنهم من عاهد الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; منهم is a fronted khabar (predicate), and من is a relative [noun], a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause عاهد الله is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿لئن آتانا من فضله لنصدقن ولنكونن من الصالحين﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is conditional; آتانا is a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿لنصدقن﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; نصَّدَّقن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being نحن (we); the clause ﴿لنصدقن﴾ is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath. لنكونن is conjoined to لنصدقن; من الصالحين is the khabar of نكونن, and the noun of نكون is latent, its implied form being نحن. The clause ﴿ومنهم من عاهد الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿فلما آتاهم من فضله بخلوا به وتولوا وهم معرضون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is temporal, meaning "when" (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa); آتاهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من فضله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آتاهم; the clause بخلوا به has no grammatical position; تولوا is conjoined to بخلوا; the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and معرضون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فأعقبهم نفاقا في قلوبهم إلى يوم يلقونه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أعقبهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); نفاقًا is the second mafʿūl bihi; في قلوبهم is an adjective (ṣifa) of نفاقًا, i.e. established and firmly rooted in their hearts; إلى يوم is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. extending; the clause يلقونه is what the adverb is put in construct with.
﴿بما أخلفوا الله ما وعدوه وبما كانوا يكذبون﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition of causation, and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e. because of their breaking with Allah the promise; الله is the object of أخلفوا; ما is maṣdariyya, and it with what falls within its scope is the object of أخلفوا. وبما كانوا يكذبون: the wāw is a conjunction, the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is maṣdariyya; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative [Translator's note: so in the source, although ما has just been called maṣdariyya], with no grammatical position, and the clause يكذبون, made of verb and fāʿil, is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿ألم يعلموا أن الله يعلم سرهم ونجواهم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (inkār); يعلموا is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by لم; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of يعلموا; سرهم is the object of يعلم, and نجواهم is conjoined to سرهم.
﴿وأن الله علام الغيوب﴾: أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun, and علام الغيوب is its khabar (predicate); it is conjoined to the first أن.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات﴾: الذين is in the position of a khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هم (they), or it is a mubtadaʾ; يلمزون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; المطوعين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من المؤمنين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); في الصدقات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يلمزون.
﴿والذين لا يجدون إلا جهدهم﴾: conjoined to الذين يلمزون; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and جهدهم is the object of يجدون.
﴿فيسخرون منهم﴾: conjoined to يلمزون; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يسخرون.
﴿سخر الله منهم ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: the clause سخر الله منهم is the khabar of الذين; لهم is a fronted khabar, عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and أليم is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿استغفر لهم أو لا تستغفر لهم﴾: an imperative verb; أو is for choice (takhyīr) and conjunction; لا is prohibitive, and تستغفر is jussive (majzūm) by لا; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
﴿إن تستغفر لهم سبعين مرة فلن يغفر الله لهم﴾: إن is conditional; تستغفر is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تستغفر; سبعين is an adverb (ẓarf), and مرة is a tamyīz (specification); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); لن is an accusative-governing particle, and يغفر is accusative (manṣūb) by لن; الله is the fāʿil (agent), and لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر.
﴿ذلك بأنهم كفروا بالله ورسوله والله لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين﴾: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and بأنهم is the khabar (predicate); أن and what falls within its scope is a maṣdar made genitive by the bāʾ; the clause كفروا is the khabar of أن; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كفروا, and رسوله is conjoined to الله; الله is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يهدي is the khabar; القوم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الفاسقين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿فرح المخلفون بمقعدهم خلاف رسول الله﴾: فرح المخلفون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بمقعدهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فرح; خلاف is accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. they stayed behind in order to oppose him, or opposing him; or it is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) by an implied verb indicated by His words مقعدهم, since it carries the meaning of تخلفوا (they stayed behind), i.e. «تخلفوا خلاف رسول الله»; or it is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), i.e. after the Messenger of Allah.
﴿وكرهوا أن يجاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم في سبيل الله﴾: conjoined to فرح المخلفون; أن and what falls within its scope is the object of كرهوا, i.e. they disliked going out to jihad.
﴿وقالوا لا تنفروا في الحر قل نار جهنم أشد حرا لو كانوا يفقهون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تنفروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; في الحر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تنفروا; قل is an imperative verb; نار جهنم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), أشد is the khabar (predicate), and حرًّا is a tamyīz (specification); لو is conditional; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and the clause يفقهون is its khabar; the answer to لو is omitted, its implied form being «ما تخلفوا» (they would not have stayed behind).

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿فليضحكوا قليلا وليبكوا كثيرا﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; the lām is the lām of command, and يضحكوا is jussive (majzūm) by it; قليلا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), since it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. «ضحكًا قليلا» (a little laughter), or it is an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. «وقتًا قليلا» (a little time); ﴿وليبكوا كثيرًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ليضحكوا قليلا﴾.
﴿جزاء بما كانوا يكسبون﴾: جزاء is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. for the sake of recompense, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, i.e. «يجزون جزاء» (they are recompensed with a recompense); بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جزاء, or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of it; ما is maṣdariyya, or a relative; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and the clause يكسبون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿فإن رجعك الله إلى طائفة منهم فاستأذنوك للخروج﴾: the fāʾ is for deriving the command (tafrīʿiyya); إن is conditional; رجعك الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent), the verb being the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); إلى طائفة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رجعك; منهم is an adjective (ṣifa); فاستأذنوك is conjoined to رجعك; للخروج is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استأذنوك.
﴿فقل لن تخرجوا معي أبدا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لن is a particle of negation, accusative and future; تخرجوا is an imperfect, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, and the wāw is the fāʿil; معي is an adverb of place attached to تخرجوا, and أبدًا is an adverb of time, also attached to تخرجوا.
﴿ولن تقاتلوا معي عدوا﴾: conjoined to لن تخرجوا; عدوا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إنكم رضيتم بالقعود أول مرة﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, and the clause رضيتم is its khabar (predicate); بالقعود is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رضيتم﴾; أول مرة is an adverb of time, or a maṣdar of something omitted, the implied form being: the first going-out you were called to.
﴿فاقعدوا مع الخالفين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; اقعدوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; مع is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to اقعدوا, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of اقعدوا; الخالفين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿ولا تصل على أحد منهم مات أبدا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لا is prohibitive; تصل is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and its fāʿil (agent) is أنت (you); على أحد is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تصل; منهم is an adjective (ṣifa) of أحد, and the clause مات is a second adjective; أبدًا is an adverb of time attached to تصل; the clause ﴿ولا تصل...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تقم على قبره﴾: conjoined to ولا تصل; على قبره is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقم.
﴿إنهم كفروا بالله ورسوله وماتوا وهم فاسقون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause كفروا is its khabar (predicate); بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كفروا, and رسوله is conjoined to it; ماتوا is conjoined to كفروا; the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and فاسقون is the khabar, the clause being accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿إنهم...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿ولا تعجبك أموالهم وأولادهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; تعجبك is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), أموالهم is the fāʿil (agent), and أولادهم is conjoined to أموالهم.
﴿إنما يريد الله أن يعذبهم بها في الدنيا﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يريد الله is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; أن and what falls within its scope is the object of يريد; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعذبهم; في الدنيا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وتزهق أنفسهم وهم كافرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and تزهق is conjoined to يعذبهم; أنفسهم is the fāʿil; the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and كافرون is the khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿وإذا أنزلت سورة أن آمنوا بالله وجاهدوا مع رسوله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is a future adverb including the meaning of condition; أنزلت is a past verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), and سورة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أن is explicative (tafsīriyya), since sending down carries the meaning of saying without its letters, or it is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن آمنوا» (that you should believe); بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا; وجاهدوا مع رسوله is conjoined to آمنوا بالله.
﴿استأذنك أولو الطول منهم﴾: the clause استأذنك is the answer to إذا; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), أولو الطول is the fāʿil (agent), and منهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿وإذا أنزلت سورة...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وقالوا ذرنا نكن مع القاعدين﴾: ذرنا: an imperative verb, and نا is the mafʿūl bihi; نكن is the answer to the command, and therefore jussive (majzūm); the noun of نكن is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being نحن (we); مع القاعدين is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of نكن.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿رضوا بأن يكونوا مع الخوالف﴾: the clause رضوا is resumptive with no grammatical position; بأن يكونوا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رضوا; the wāw is the noun of يكونوا, and مع الخوالف is the khabar (predicate).
﴿وطبع على قلوبهم فهم لا يفقهون﴾: conjoined to رضوا; على قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to طبع. فهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause لا يفقهون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿لكن الرسول والذين آمنوا معه جاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم﴾: لكن is lightened and inoperative (mukhaffafa muhmala); الرسول is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذين is conjoined to it; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; معه is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا; the clause جاهدوا بأموالهم وأنفسهم is the khabar (predicate) of الرسول.
﴿وأولئك لهم الخيرات﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; لهم is a fronted khabar, and الخيرات is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause لهم الخيرات is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿وأولئك هم المفلحون﴾: أولئك: a mubtadaʾ; هم: a second mubtadaʾ; المفلحون: the khabar of هم; the clause: the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿أعد الله لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; أعد is a past verb, and الله is its fāʿil (agent); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعد; جنات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause تجري is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿خالدين فيها ذلك الفوز العظيم﴾: خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدين; ذلك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الفوز العظيم is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿وجاء المعذرون من الأعراب ليؤذن لهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; جاء المعذرون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من الأعراب is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ليؤذن: the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and [يؤذن is] an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاء; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤذن﴾.
﴿وقعد الذين كذبوا الله ورسوله﴾: conjoined to ﴿جاء﴾; الذين is the fāʿil; كذبوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is the object of كذبوا, and رسوله is conjoined to it.
﴿سيصيب الذين كفروا منهم عذاب أليم﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; يصيب is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو (it) [Translator's note: so in the source, which then names عذاب as the fāʿil; عذاب is the agent here]; الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; عذاب is the fāʿil of يصيب, and أليم is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿ليس على الضعفاء ولا على المرضى ولا على الذين لا يجدون ما ينفقون حرج﴾: ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; على الضعفاء is the fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; ولا على المرضى is conjoined to الضعفاء, and ولا على الذين لا يجدون ما ينفقون is also conjoined; حرج is the noun of ليس.
﴿إذا نصحوا لله ورسوله ما على المحسنين من سبيل والله غفور رحيم﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implicit meaning drawn from the negation, i.e. the blame is removed from them when they are sincere, so they do not go out in that case; the clause نصحوا is in the position of genitive through the adverb being put in construct with it; رسوله is conjoined to لله; ما is negating; على المحسنين is a fronted khabar; من is a connective (ṣila) particle [i.e. redundant], and سبيل is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) by position; الله is a mubtadaʾ, غفور is a first khabar, and رحيم is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿ولا على الذين إذا ما أتوك لتحملهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating; على الذين is conjoined to His words ﴿على الضعفاء﴾, so it stands as a fronted khabar (predicate), and the mubtadaʾ (subject) is omitted, i.e. «حرج» (blame); the clause ﴿إذا ما أتوك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; إذا is a future adverb, ما is connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant], and the clause أتوك is what the adverb is put in construct with; لتحملهم is the reason for the coming.
﴿قلت لا أجد ما أحملكم عليه﴾: the clause قلت is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) from the kāf in أتوك, with وقد implied before it, i.e. when they came to you while you were saying: I do not find; ما is the object of أجد; the clause أحملكم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحملكم.
﴿تولوا وأعينهم تفيض من الدمع﴾: the clause تولوا is the answer to إذا; or the clause ﴿قلت لا أجد﴾ is the answer to the conditional إذا, إذا and its answer being in the place of the ṣila, and on this view His words تولوا are an answer to an implied question, as though someone asked: what was their state when they were given this answer? and the answer was given by His words: تولوا. أعينهم is a mubtadaʾ, the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause تفيض is the khabar; من الدمع is a tamyīz (specification), i.e. «تفيض دمعًا» (overflow with tears).
﴿حزنا﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. they turned away grieving, or their eyes overflow grieving; or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «يحزنون حزنا» (they grieve with grief).
﴿أن لا يجدوا﴾: أن and what falls within its scope is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, or is in the position of genitive by the lām or by من, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿تفيض﴾.
﴿ما ينفقون﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is the object of يجدوا, and the clause ﴿ينفقون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿إنما السبيل على الذين يستأذنونك وهم أغنياء﴾: إنما is [إنّ] restrained [by] the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); السبيل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿على الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause يستأذنونك is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. وهم: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ, and أغنياء is the khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿رضوا بأن يكونوا مع الخوالف﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, or circumstantial with قد implied; ﴿بأن يكونوا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رضوا﴾; the wāw is the noun of يكونوا, and ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to its omitted khabar.
﴿وطبع الله على قلوبهم﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes; طبع is a past verb, and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿على قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to طبع.
﴿فهم لا يعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هم is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يعلمون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿يعتذرون إليكم إذا رجعتم إليهم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعتذرون; إذا is a future adverb attached to its omitted answer, i.e. «يعتذرون» (they make excuses); the clause رجعتم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رجعتم.
﴿قل لا تعتذروا لن نؤمن لكم﴾: the clause لا تعتذروا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause لن نؤمن لكم is resumptive with no grammatical position; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نؤمن.
﴿قد نبأنا الله من أخباركم﴾: قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); نبأنا has here made two objects accusative, the first of them ﴿نا﴾, and the second the one attached to the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿من أخباركم﴾; as for the third object, it has been omitted for brevity because it is known, the implied form being: «نبأنا الله من أخباركم كذبًا وأراجيف» (Allah has informed us of your news as lies and false rumours).
﴿وسيرى الله عملكم ورسوله﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; يرى is an imperfect verb, and الله is the fāʿil (agent); seeing here means knowing; عملكم is the first object of يرى, and the second is omitted, its implied form being «واقعًا» (occurring); رسوله is conjoined to الله.
﴿ثم تردون إلى عالم الغيب والشهادة﴾: ثم is a conjunction for order with delay; تردون is an imperfect verb and a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إلى عالم الغيب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تردون.
﴿فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ينبئكم is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the kāf is its first object; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object; the clause تعملون is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. «تعملونه» (you do it); ما here is a relative, or maṣdariyya.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿سيحلفون بالله لكم إذا انقلبتم إليهم لتعرضوا عنهم﴾: the sīn is for emphasis along with the future; يحلفون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يحلفون; the clause is a badal (substitute) from يعتذرون; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); what is sworn to is omitted, relying on the reader's understanding, i.e. that they are excused in their staying behind; إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to يحلفون; إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انقلبتم. لتعرضوا: the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and تعرضوا is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after it, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to يحلفون; the accusative of the mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) was not possible because the agents differ, i.e. so that you leave off reproaching them; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تعرضوا.
﴿فأعرضوا عنهم إنهم رجس ومأواهم جهنم جزاء بما كانوا يكسبون﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; ﴿أعرضوا﴾ is an imperative verb; ﴿مأواهم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿جهنم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿جزاء﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, i.e. for the sake of recompense, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «يجزون جزاء» (they are recompensed with a recompense); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جزاء﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and the clause ﴿يكسبون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿يحلفون لكم لترضوا عنهم﴾: يحلفون is a badal (substitute) from سيحلفون; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يحلفون, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the causal lām together with its genitive is attached to يحلفون; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ترضوا.
﴿فإن ترضوا عنهم فإن الله لا يرضى عن القوم الفاسقين﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa, and the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, i.e. if you are pleased with them, your being pleased will not benefit them. ﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīl); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يرضى عن القوم الفاسقين﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿الأعراب أشد كفرا ونفاقا﴾: الأعراب is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and أشد is the khabar (predicate); كفرًا is a tamyīz (specification), and نفاقًا is conjoined to it.
﴿وأجدر ألا يعلموا حدود ما أنزل الله على رسوله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أجدر is conjoined to أشد; ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن لا يعلموا» (that they should not know), and it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أجدر﴾; حدود is the object of يعلموا; ﴿ما﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause ﴿أنزل الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾: a mubtadaʾ and its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿ومن الأعراب من يتخذ ما ينفق مغرما﴾: ﴿من الأعراب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); مَن is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يتخذ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position, and the fāʿil (agent) of يتخذ is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو (he); ما is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ينفق is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; مغرمًا is the second object of يتخذ.
﴿ويتربص بكم الدوائر﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, or a conjunction; يتربص falls under the ruling of the ṣila; ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الدوائر is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿عليهم دائرة السوء والله سميع عليم﴾: the clause is a supplication (duʿāʾiyya) with no grammatical position; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar, and دائرة السوء is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, سميع is its first khabar, and عليم is its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿ومن الأعراب من يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: من الأعراب is a fronted khabar (predicate), and من is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يؤمن بالله is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; اليوم الآخر is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾.
﴿ويتخذ ما ينفق قربات عند الله وصلوات الرسول﴾: يتخذ is conjoined to يؤمن, and its fāʿil (agent) is هو (he); ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ينفق is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; قربات is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عند الله﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa); ﴿وصلوات الرسول﴾ is conjoined to قربات, or conjoined to ﴿ما ينفق﴾, its implied form being: «وصلوات الرسول قربات» (and the prayers of the Messenger as means of nearness), قربات being the second object of يتخذ.
﴿ألا إنها قربة لهم سيدخلهم الله في رحمته﴾: ألا is a particle of alerting (tanbīh), and the clause is resumptive, emphasised by ألا, with no grammatical position; ﴿إنها﴾ is for the firmness of the matter; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and قربة is its khabar; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of قربة. ﴿سيدخلهم﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future, and ﴿يدخلهم الله﴾ is an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; ﴿في رحمته﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدخلهم﴾.
﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غفور رحيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿والسابقون الأولون من المهاجرين والأنصار والذين اتبعوهم بإحسان﴾: السابقون is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الأولون is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿من المهاجرين والأنصار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الذين is conjoined to ﴿السابقون﴾; the clause اتبعوهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; بإحسان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿السابقون﴾.
﴿وأعد لهم جنات تجري تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أعد is a past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعد; جنات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿تجري تحتها الأنهار﴾ is an adjective of جنات; خالدين is a ḥāl, and أبدًا is an adverb of time attached to خالدين.
﴿ذلك الفوز العظيم﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; العظيم is an adjective of الفوز.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿وممن حولكم من الأعراب منافقون﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; ممن is a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿حولكم﴾, the adverb, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿من الأعراب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); منافقون is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ومن أهل المدينة مردوا على النفاق﴾: ﴿ومن أهل المدينة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted that is conjoined to the مَن made genitive by مِن, so the two genitives share in being predicated of the mubtadaʾ, which is منافقون, as though it were said: the hypocrites are from a people around you and from the people of Medina. Or the speech is complete at His words منافقون, and His words ﴿ومن أهل المدينة﴾ are a fronted khabar, the mubtadaʾ after it being omitted with its adjective standing in its place; omitting the thing qualified and putting its adjective in its place is regular, the implied form being: «ومن أهل المدينة قوم مردوا على النفاق» (and among the people of Medina are a people who have persisted in hypocrisy).
﴿لا تعلمهم نحن نعلمهم سنعذبهم مرتين﴾: the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿منافقون﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position; نحن is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause نعلمهم is the khabar; the second object of نعلمهم is omitted, its implied form being «منافقين» (hypocrites), and likewise the second object of تعلمهم. ﴿سنعذبهم﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; نعذبهم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مرتين stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), since it is its number.
﴿ثم يردون إلى عذاب عظيم﴾: the clause is conjoined; يردون is a verb and a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يردون, and عظيم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿وآخرين اعترفوا بذنوبهم خلطوا عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source heading; the Quranic text, and the discussion below, have ﴿وآخرون﴾]: ﴿وآخرون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿منافقون﴾, or is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿اعترفوا بذنوبهم﴾ is its adjective (ṣifa), and the clause ﴿خلطوا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿عملا﴾ is the object of خلطوا, and صالحًا is an adjective; ﴿آخر﴾ is conjoined to عملا, and سيئًا is an adjective.
﴿عسى الله أن يتوب عليهم إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: ﴿عسى﴾ is one of the verbs of approximation (muqāraba) and conveys hope; ﴿الله﴾ is its noun, and ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the khabar; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتوب﴾; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غفور رحيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿خذ من أموالهم صدقة تطهرهم وتزكيهم بها﴾: ﴿خذ﴾ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is ﴿أنت﴾ (you); من أموالهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خذ﴾, the meaning of ﴿مِن﴾ being partitive (tabʿīḍ); صدقة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). Or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), since it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of صدقة, and when it was put first it became accusative as a ḥāl from it. The clause تطهرهم is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ﴿خذ﴾.
﴿وصل عليهم إن صلاتك سكن لهم والله سميع عليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and صل is conjoined to خذ; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿صل﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), صلاتك is its noun, and سكن is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿سكن﴾; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and سميع عليم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿ألم يعلموا أن الله هو يقبل التوبة عن عباده﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (taqrīr); لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يعلموا is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by لم; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of يعلموا; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يقبل is its khabar (predicate), the clause being the khabar of أن; عن عباده is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقبل﴾.
﴿ويأخذ الصدقات﴾: a coordinating conjunction (ʿaṭf nasaq) onto what precedes.
﴿وأن الله هو التواب الرحيم﴾: أن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; هو is a mubtadaʾ, التواب is the khabar of ﴿هو﴾, and الرحيم is a second khabar; the clause ﴿هو التواب﴾ is the khabar of أن.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿وقل اعملوا فسيرى الله عملكم ورسوله والمؤمنون﴾: the clause اعملوا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يرى﴾, and عملكم is its object; رسوله والمؤمنون are conjoined to ﴿الله﴾.
﴿وستردون إلى عالم الغيب والشهادة﴾: conjoined to ﴿سيرى﴾; ﴿إلى عالم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تردون﴾; الغيب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الشهادة is conjoined to الغيب.
﴿فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينبئكم﴾; the clause كنتم تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿وآخرون مرجون لأمر الله﴾: a coordinating conjunction (ʿaṭf nasaq) onto what precedes, i.e. «وآخرون اعترفوا» (and others who confessed); مرجون is its adjective (ṣifa); لأمر الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مرجون﴾.
﴿إما يعذبهم وإما يتوب عليهم والله عليم حكيم﴾: ﴿إما﴾ is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); يعذبهم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. they are deferred, either being punished or being turned to in forgiveness. Or ﴿آخرون﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), مرجون is its adjective, and the clause ﴿إما يعذبهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿آخرون﴾, and وإما يتوب عليهم is conjoined; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and عليم حكيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿والذين اتخذوا مسجدا ضرارا وكفرا وتفريقا بين المؤمنين﴾: you have two options for ﴿الذين﴾: the accusative of singling out (ikhtiṣāṣ) for blame, like His words, Exalted is He, ﴿والمقيمين الصلاة﴾ on singling out for praise; or the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), with the khabar (predicate) omitted, its meaning being: among those whom We have described are those who took..., like His words, Exalted is He, ﴿والسارق والسارقة﴾, the implied form being: «فيما يتلى عليكم الذين» (among what is recited to you are those who...), so the khabar was omitted and the mubtadaʾ kept. The wāw is resumptive in every case. The clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position, and ﴿مسجدًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ضرارًا﴾ is a second object of ﴿اتخذوا﴾, or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. to harm their brothers; or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. they harm others thereby with harm; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿اتخذوا﴾, i.e. they took it while harming their brothers. ﴿كفرًا وتفريقًا﴾ are conjoined to ﴿ضرارًا﴾. ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تفريقًا﴾. The clause ﴿والذين اتخذوا مسجدا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وإرصادًا لمن حارب الله ورسوله من قبل﴾: إرصادًا is also conjoined; لمن حارب الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿إرصادًا﴾; the clause حارب الله is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حارب﴾.
﴿وليحلفن إن أردنا إلا الحسنى﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; إن is negating; أردنا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the answer to the oath; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and الحسنى is the object of أردنا.
﴿والله يشهد إنهم لكاذبون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يشهد is the khabar; إن and what falls within its scope is the object of يشهد; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and كاذبون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿لا تقم فيه أبدا﴾: لا is prohibitive; تقم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقم﴾; أبدًا is an adverb (ẓarf), also attached to ﴿تقم﴾.
﴿لمسجد أسس على التقوى من أول يوم أحق أن تقوم فيه﴾: the lām is of inception (ibtidāʾ); مسجد is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause أسس على التقوى is an adjective (ṣifa) of مسجد; على التقوى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسس﴾; أحق is its khabar (predicate); من أول يوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or to أسس; ﴿أن تقوم﴾ is a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن تقوم فيه» (that you should stand in it), and it is attached to أحق; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقوم﴾.
﴿فيه رجال يحبون أن يتطهروا والله يحب المطهرين﴾: ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; رجال is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause يحبون is an adjective of رجال; أن and what falls within its scope is the object of يحبون; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يحب المطهرين is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿أفمن أسس بنيانه على تقوى من الله ورضوان خير﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (taqrīr); the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause أسس بنيانه is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; على تقوى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسس; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of تقوى; رضوان is conjoined to تقوى; خير is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿أم من أسس بنيانه على شفا جرف هار﴾: أم is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿مَن﴾, and its khabar is omitted, its implied form being خير (better); على شفا جرف هار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسس.
﴿فانهار به في نار جهنم والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and انهار is conjoined to أسس; its fāʿil (agent) is either the pronoun of the building or the pronoun of the bank, and the latter is preferable; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿انهار﴾ if the bāʾ is for making transitive (taʿdiya), and to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) if it is for accompaniment (muṣāḥaba); ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾ is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿لا يزال بنيانهم الذي بنوا ريبة في قلوبهم﴾: بنيانهم is the noun of ﴿لا يزال﴾; الذي: an adjective (ṣifa) of بنيانهم; the clause ﴿بنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ريبة is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿لا يزال﴾; ﴿في قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿ريبة﴾.
﴿إلا أن تقطع قلوبهم والله عليم حكيم﴾: an exception from the most general of times, so on this view the thing excepted from is omitted, i.e. their building will remain a doubt at every one of the times except the time of the cutting up of their hearts; أن is maṣdariyya; تقطع, originally تتقطع, is accusative (manṣūb) by it, and قلوبهم is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and عليم حكيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿براءة من الله ورسوله إلى الذين عاهدتم من المشركين﴾: براءة is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: this is a declaration of disassociation (هذه براءة); ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of براءة; and ﴿إلى الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to براءة. Or براءة is the mubtadaʾ, and إلى الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar. عاهدتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and من المشركين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿فسيحوا في الأرض أربعة أشهر﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; the clause سيحوا is the object of an omitted saying, i.e.: so say, O Muslims, to the polytheists: travel (سيحوا); في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سيحوا; and أربعة أشهر is an adverb of time attached to سيحوا.
﴿واعلموا أنكم غير معجزي الله﴾: the و is a particle of conjunction; اعلموا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); أن and what falls in its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ك is its noun, and غير معجزي is its khabar (predicate); and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وأن الله مخزي الكافرين﴾: أن is conjoined to أنكم; the Name of Majesty is its noun, and مخزي الكافرين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وأذان من الله ورسوله إلى الناس يوم الحج الأكبر﴾: the و is a conjunction; أذان is conjoined to براءة, and the clause is conjoined to its like; من الله is its naʿt (adjective), or attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; إلى الناس is the khabar (predicate); and يوم الحج الأكبر is an adverb attached to what إلى الناس is attached to.
﴿أن الله بريء من المشركين ورسوله﴾: with fatḥa on the hamza of أن, the khabar of أذان, or a naʿt, i.e.: and an announcement being with the disassociation; and it is said: the implied form is: and a notification from Allah of the disassociation, so the ب is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) itself. أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and بريء is its khabar; من المشركين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بريء. As for رسوله, there are several views on it: the first is that it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: and His Messenger is free of them, and it was omitted only because the first indicates it, and this is the soundest of the views; and it is said: it is conjoined to the position of the noun of أن, or conjoined to the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the khabar.
﴿فإن تبتم فهو خير لكم﴾: the ف is a conjunction, or resumptive; إن is conditional; تبتم is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the ف is linking; هو is the mubtadaʾ and خير is its khabar; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير; and the clause ﴿فإن تبتم..﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن توليتم فاعلموا أنكم غير معجزي الله﴾: the و is a conjunction; وإن توليتم is conjoined to إن تبتم; ﴿أنكم﴾: أن is an abrogating particle and the ك is its noun, and it stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا; ﴿غير﴾ is the khabar of أن; and معجزي الله is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وبشر الذين كفروا بعذاب أليم﴾: the و is a conjunction; بشر is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is latent; الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; بعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بشر; and أليم is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿إلا الذين عاهدتم من المشركين﴾: a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), i.e.: but as for those with whom you made a covenant, their ruling is such-and-such; so الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the clause فأتموا. Or a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil), so it is excepted from the polytheists in His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿براءة من الله ورسوله﴾ to ﴿الذين عاهدتم من المشركين﴾. The clause عاهدتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and من المشركين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ثم لم ينقصوكم شيئا ولم يظاهروا عليكم أحدا﴾: ثم is a particle of conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī); لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; ينقصوكم is jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; شيئًا is either a second object of ﴿نَقَصَ﴾, because it is transitive to one and to two objects, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an attribute of the maṣdar, i.e.: anything of diminution. ﴿لم يظاهروا﴾ is conjoined to لم ينقصوكم; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يظاهروا; and أحدًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فأتموا إليهم عهدهم إلى مدتهم إن الله يحب المتقين﴾: the ف is a conjunction; أتموا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أتموا; عهدهم is the mafʿūl bihi; إلى مدتهم is a badal (substitute) for إليهم; and إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يحب المتقين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فإذا انسلخ الأشهر الحرم﴾: the ف is a conjunction, or resumptive; إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition; the clause انسلخ is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; الأشهر is the fāʿil (agent); and الحرم is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿فاقتلوا المشركين حيث وجدتموهم﴾: the ف is linking; اقتلوا المشركين is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حيث is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) اقتلوا; the clause وجدتموهم is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; and the clause ﴿فإذا انسلخ الأشهر...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وخذوهم واحصروهم واقعدوا لهم كل مرصد﴾: خذوهم is conjoined to اقتلوا. احصروهم is likewise conjoined. اقعدوا is likewise conjoined. لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اقعدوا﴾. ﴿كل﴾ is an adverb of place, accusative; and it is said: accusative by removal of the preposition, the implied preposition being ﴿على﴾ or ﴿الباء الظرفية﴾ (the locative bāʾ) or ﴿في﴾. ﴿مرصد﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فإن تابوا وأقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة فخلوا سبيلهم﴾: the ف is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تابوا is a verb and its fāʿil, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); أقاموا الصلاة is conjoined to تابوا, and likewise a verb and its fāʿil in the position of a jussive as the protasis; أقاموا الصلاة is conjoined to تابوا, and آتوا الزكاة [Translator's note: the source repeats this phrase; translated as written]. فخلوا: the ف is linking, خلوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and سبيلهم is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غفور رحيم are its two khabars (predicates); and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
